max_reported_eps_guidance.description: Reported Earnings Per Share - Maximum guidance value

max_reported_eps_guidance_2.description: Reported Earnings Per Share - Maximum guidance value for the annual period

max_reported_pretax_income_guidance.description: Reported Pretax income- maximum guidance value

max_reported_pretax_income_guidance_2.description: Reported Pretax income- maximum guidance value

max_reported_pretax_profit_quarterly_est.description: The highest broker estimate for reported pretax profit in the current quarter.

max_research_development_expense_guidanc.description: The maximum guidance value for Research and Development Expense.

max_selling_general_admin_guidance.description: The maximum guidance value for Selling, General & Administrative Expense

max_share_buyback_guidance.description: Maximum guidance value for Shares Basic - Annual

max_shareholders_equity_guidance.description: The maximum guidance value for Total Shareholders' Equity.

max_software_useful_life.description: Maximum useful life assigned to software assets.

max_stock_option_expense_guidance.description: Stock option expense - Maximum guidance value for the annual period

max_tangible_book_value_per_share_guidan.description: Tangible Book Value per Share - maximum guidance value

max_total_assets_guidance.description: The maximum guidance value for Total Assets.

max_total_assets_guidance_2.description: The maximum guidance value for Total Assets

max_total_assets_quarterly_estimate.description: The highest broker estimate for total assets in the current quarter.

max_total_goodwill_guidance.description: The maximum guidance value for Total Goodwill.

max_total_goodwill_guidance_2.description: The maximum guidance value for Total Goodwill on an annual basis.

max_upward_price_move.description: Maximum upward price movement (absolute value) after the event within the session

max_upward_price_move_pct.description: Percent change from price at the time of the news to session high after the news

max_useful_life_buildings_land.description: Maximum useful life assigned to buildings and land assets.

maximum_downward_amount_pre.description: Difference between the price at the time of the news and the lowest price after the news

maximum_downward_movement_amount.description: Difference between price at time of news and lowest price after news

maximum_downward_movement_percent.description: Lowest percent drop from time of news to post-news session low

maximum_downward_percent_change_1555.description: Percent change from the news time price to the lowest price reached after the news

maximum_downward_percent_pre.description: Percent change from the price at the time of the news to the lowest price after the news

maximum_downward_price_movement_1555.description: Difference between the price at the time of the news and the lowest price after the news

maximum_guidance_value.description: Maximum guidance value for basic annual financials

maximum_upward_amount_pre.description: Difference between the highest price after the news and the price at the time of the news

maximum_upward_movement_amount.description: Maximum upward price movement after the news event, specifically calculated as the highest price after news minus the price at the time of the news

maximum_upward_movement_percent.description: Highest percent gain from time of news to post-news session high

maximum_upward_percent_change_1555.description: Percent change from the news time price to the highest price reached after the news

maximum_upward_percent_pre.description: Percent change from the price at the time of the news to the highest price after the news

maximum_upward_price_movement_1555.description: Maximum price increase after the news, calculated as post-news high minus price at news time

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yb.description: 5-year Relative Book-to-Market: current book-to-market minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yc.description: 5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Cash Flow-to-Price: current TTM cash flow-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation
5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Core Earnings-to-Price: current TTM core earnings-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yd.description: 5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Dividend Yield: current dividend yield minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ye.description: 5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month EBITDA-to-Price: current TTM EBITDA per share-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation
5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Earnings-to-Price: current TTM EPS before extra items-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yf.description: 5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Free Cash Flow-to-Price: current TTM free cash flow-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation
5-year Relative Leading 12-Month Earnings Yield: next 4-quarter consensus analyst earnings-to-price ratio minus the 60-month average, scaled by the standard deviation

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yo.description: 5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: current TTM operating cash flow-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_2_5yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ys.description: 5-year Relative Trailing 12-Month Sales-to-Price: current TTM sales-to-price minus the 60-month average, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_acqmul.description: Most recent invested capital divided by trailing 12-month EBITDA

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_bp.description: Book value per share divided by month-end trading price (book-to-market ratio)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_cashp.description: Most recently reported cash and equivalents per share divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_cashsev.description: Cash and equivalents divided by enterprise value

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_coreepsp.description: Trailing 12-month core earnings per share from operations (excludes special items) divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_curep.description: Current Earnings Yield (sum of recent 3 quarters EPS and analyst estimates, divided by price)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_divyield.description: Trailing 12-month dividends per share divided by month-end trading price (dividend yield)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ebitdaev.description: Trailing 12-month EBITDA divided by enterprise value

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ebitdap.description: Trailing 12-month EBITDA per share divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_f12mepssev.description: Forward 12-month earnings per share divided by enterprise value

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_fwdep.description: Forward 12-month earnings-to-price ratio (mean consensus EPS divided by trading price)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_navp.description: Most recent net asset value per share divided by price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_nnastp.description: Net current assets per share (current assets minus total liabilities) divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_past.description: Price-to-total assets ratio (month-end trading price divided by total assets per share)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_proformaep.description: Trailing 12-month pro forma earnings-to-price (excludes special items)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmcapexp.description: Trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmcfp.description: Trailing 12-month cash flow (net income plus depreciation) per share divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmepa.description: Trailing 12-month earnings per share after special items divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmepb.description: Trailing 12-month earnings per share before non-recurring items divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmfcfev.description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by enterprise value

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmfcfp.description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow per share divided by month-end trading price (operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends)

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmgfp.description: Trailing 12-month growth flow-to-price (GAAP earnings plus R&D) per share divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmocfp.description: Trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmpiqp.description: Trailing 12-month pretax income per share (operating plus nonoperating) divided by trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmsaleev.description: Trailing 12-month sales divided by enterprise value

mdl177_2_deepvaluefactor_ttmsp.description: Trailing 12-month sales per share divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_deepvaluemodel2_dv_currroe.description: Current return on equity for the stock, computed as net income divided by shareholders’ equity for the most recent reporting period

mdl177_2_deepvaluemodel_chgshare.description: Percent change in a company's shares outstanding compared to one year ago

mdl177_2_deepvaluemodel_dv_yoychgat.description: Year-over-year change in asset turnover; measures the difference in a company's asset turnover ratio compared to one year ago

mdl177_2_deepvaluemodel_dvm_composite.description: Composite deep value score for the stock; an integrated model-based measure aggregating multiple deep value signals

mdl177_2_deepvaluemodel_indidivy.description: Indicated dividend yield; the projected annual dividend divided by current stock price

mdl177_2_deepvaluemodel_ttmfcfev.description: Trailing twelve month free cash flow to enterprise value ratio; reflects free cash flow over the past year relative to enterprise value

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_chg6ml.description: Percent change in consensus long-term earnings growth forecast compared to 6 months ago

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_cvfy1e.description: Coefficient of variance (dispersion) in FY1 EPS consensus estimates

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_cvfy2e.description: Dispersion of fiscal year 2 EPS analyst forecasts, measured as the standard deviation divided by the mean

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of the dividend yield–adjusted PEG ratio, a valuation metric

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_egp.description: Inverse of PEG Ratio, calculated as next 4-quarter's earnings estimate times long-term growth rate scaled by price

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_epsrm.description: Magnitude of the 3-month change in median FY1 consensus EPS estimate, scaled

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_fcfroe.description: Product of trailing 12-month free cash flow yield and forward return on equity

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_fy1eps.description: Skewness of the distribution of leading 12-month EPS consensus estimates

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_hlep.description: Street revision confidence: sum of changes in highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimates over 3 months, scaled

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_lagegp.description: Lagged Inverse of PEG Ratio : It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items times the change in yearly trailing 12-month sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price.

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_ltg.description: Consensus long-term expected annual earnings growth rate

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_numrev.description: Net number of upward minus downward revisions for fiscal quarter 1 EPS forecasts
Net number of upward minus downward revisions in FY1 EPS forecasts

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_perg.description: Risk-adjusted PEG ratio: price divided by next year’s EPS forecast, scaled by average long-term growth and multiplied by 36-month beta

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_q1aeps.description: EPS growth estimate for next fiscal quarter

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_qepsfe.description: Forecast error for the prior fiscal quarter’s EPS estimates

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_ratrev.description: Average change in analyst recommendation (street rating) over previous 6 months

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_rev1q1.description: Change in fiscal quarter 1 EPS forecast compared to the prior period

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_rev6.description: Averaged revision in consensus FY1 EPS estimates over the last 6 months

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_salesu.description: Sales Surprise, indicating the difference between reported and expected sales

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_stdevf.description: Standard deviation of FY1 EPS estimates scaled by price
Standard deviation of FY2 EPS estimates scaled by price

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_stockr.description: Consensus analyst recommendation for the company

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_sue.description: Standardized Unexpected Earnings, representing the earnings surprise relative to analyst expectations in standardized form

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_surp.description: Earnings surprise: actual EPS minus forecast, scaled by price at quarter end

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_y1aeps.description: EPS growth estimate for next fiscal year

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_y2aeps.description: EPS growth estimate for two years ahead

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_y2reps.description: Projected EPS growth over two years

mdl177_2_earningmomentumfactor400_y3sur.description: Volatility-adjusted projected EPS growth over the next 3 years

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_chgsgasal.description: Difference between the yearly change in quarterly SG&A expenses and the yearly change in quarterly sales

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_chgshare.description: Percent change in number of outstanding shares compared to one year ago

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_cogsinvt.description: Absolute value of the difference between yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and yearly percent change in inventory level

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_dpcapex.description: Absolute value of the difference between yearly percent change in trailing 12-month depreciation expense and yearly percent change in trailing 12-month capital expenditure

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_epschgetr.description: Trailing 12-month pre-tax income per share times the difference between current and prior year effective tax rates (tax expense divided by pre-tax income)

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_indrelrec.description: A stock’s asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the industry average, deflated by standard deviation of industry receivables

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_ncfeps.description: Absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted EPS before extraordinary items

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_opincltd.description: Difference between the yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_saleeps.description: Absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted earnings per share before extraordinary items

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_salegpm.description: Difference between the yearly change in the most recent reported quarterly sales and the yearly change in quarterly gross profit margin

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_salerec.description: Difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_ttmaccu.description: Difference between trailing 12-month net income and trailing 12-month operating cash flow, scaled by beginning total assets

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_uaccl.description: Difference between current accrued liabilities and expected levels, scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_uap.description: Difference between current accounts payable and expected level (prior year's balance multiplied by COGS growth in trailing 12 months), scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_uar.description: Difference between current accounts receivable and expected level (prior year's balance multiplied by sales growth in trailing 12 months), scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_udep.description: Difference between trailing 12-month depreciation expenses and expected depreciation expenses (prior year’s balance multiplied by growth in total fixed assets), scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_uinv.description: Difference between current inventory level and expected inventory level, likely scaled by assets

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_wcacc.description: Sum of changes in receivables, inventory, payables, taxes, assets, and liabilities to measure working capital accruals

mdl177_2_earningsqualityfactor_yoychgaa.description: Trailing 12-month income before extra items less trailing 12-month operating cash flow, scaled by average total assets, minus same metric one year ago

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_alert.description: Ranking indicator highlighting stocks that trigger specific GARP alert signals, possibly for rapid reassessment or attention

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_avgrating.description: Average of analyst ratings for the stock, reflecting consensus analyst opinion

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_capeff.description: Measurement of how efficiently a company utilizes its capital/resources, ranked relative to peers

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_chgvaluati.description: Three-month change in valuation metrics, tracking how a stock's valuation measures have evolved over the past quarter

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_composite.description: Composite score aggregating multiple GARP-specific metrics to represent overall attractiveness based on GARP principles

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_growthval.description: Valuation of a stock adjusted for its growth metrics, used within a GARP (Growth at a Reasonable Price) analyst framework

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_relgrowth.description: Rank comparing a stock’s growth metrics to its peers, emphasizing relative growth within its universe

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_relpegy.description: A rolling ranking of stocks combining their PEGY (Price/Earnings-to-Growth-and-Yield) ratio over a set period, representing value adjusted for growth and yield relative to peers

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_roefcf.description: Combined rank measuring both Return on Equity and Free Cash Flow to capture quality and profitability

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_valuation.description: Ranking of a stock's valuation according to GARP analyst metrics, possibly considering price-to-earnings, price-to-book, etc.

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_vfpricerat.description: Ranking based on the ratio of intrinsic (fundamental, value-based) valuation to market price, indicating relative under/overvaluation

mdl177_2_garpanalystmodel_qgp_wratingchg.description: Six-month weighted change in analyst ratings, capturing recent shifts in analyst opinion

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_aci.description: Abnormal Capital Investment: measures the change in a firm's recent 12-month capital investment intensity compared to its average prior 3-year investment intensity

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_acp.description: Average Collection Period: average of trailing 12-month accounts receivable times 365 divided by trailing 12-month sales, indicating how long it takes for a company to collect payments

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_acqm.description: Acquisition Multiple: most recent invested capital divided by trailing 12-month EBITDA, showing acquisition valuation

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actr.description: 12-Month Active Return with 1-month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-13 to t-1
18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-19 to t-1
1-Month Active Return: percent change in stock price from month t-1 to t
24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-25 to t-1
2-Month Active Return: percent change in stock price from month t-2 to t
36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-37 to t-1
3-Month Active Return: percent change in stock price from month t-3 to t
60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-61 to t-1
6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-7 to t-1
9-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-10 to t-1

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_alph.description: 60-Month Alpha: intercept from regression of stock's monthly return versus S&P 500 monthly return for the past 60 months, representing risk-adjusted outperformance

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_app.description: Average Payable Period: average of trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by trailing 12-month cost of goods sold, indicating how long a company takes to pay suppliers

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_aqi.description: Asset Quality Index: year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of current assets plus PP&E to total assets, reflecting asset quality improvement or deterioration

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_aspa.description: Operating assets minus operating liabilities for the quarter, divided by lagged total assets, a balance sheet efficiency measure

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_astc.description: Asset Composition: total current assets from the most recent quarter divided by total assets from the same quarter, indicating the proportion of current assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_astt.description: Assets Turnover Ratio: trailing 12-month sales divided by most recent quarterly assets, measuring efficiency of asset usage in generating sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_bdi.description: Basic Defensive Interval: number of days a company can cover daily operating expenses solely from its cash and receivables

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_beta.description: 60-Month Beta: measure of stock's sensitivity to market movements, calculated as a weighted average (0.67 × 60-month beta + 0.33 × beta) using covariance of stock and S&P 500 monthly returns
Product of Beta and Sigma: product of 60-month adjusted beta and 60-month standard deviation of monthly returns, a risk metric

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_book.description: Book Leverage: most recent quarterly total assets divided by book equity, a leverage ratio

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_bp.description: Book-to-Market: most recent book value per share divided by month-end trading price, a value investing measure

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_capa.description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: trailing 12-month operating cash flow less cash dividends, divided by total expenditures in the same period, a management quality/profitability measure

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cape.description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by most recent quarter's total assets, a capital investment measure
TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Sales: trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by trailing 12-month sales, indicating capital intensity relative to sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cash.description: Rate at which a company burns cash; computed as negative (operating cash flow plus investing cash flow) divided by cash and short-term investments
Cash conversion cycle in days: inventory days plus receivables days minus payables days
Cash and equivalents per share divided by trading price (cash-to-price ratio)
Cash and equivalents divided by current liabilities (cash ratio)
Cash-to-sales ratio: trailing 12-month average cash and equivalents divided by trailing 12-month sales
Total cash and equivalents divided by enterprise value

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ccd.description: Current cash flow debt coverage: (cash flow from operations minus dividends) divided by current interest-bearing debt

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cfit.description: Trailing 12-month investing cash flow divided by average total assets over the last four quarters

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cfle.description: Total liabilities divided by trailing 12-month operating cash flow (cash flow leverage)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cfro.description: Trailing 12-month cash flow divided by average invested capital (equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cg3y.description: Geometric growth rate of trailing 12-month sales per share over the last 12 quarters (3-year compound annual growth)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3.description: Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month operating cash flow: current minus 12 quarters ago, scaled by average total assets
Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month cash flow per share: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by price
Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS (before extra items): current minus 12 quarters ago, scaled by average assets per share
Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by month-end trading price
Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by average total assets
Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow per share: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by month-end trading price
Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month operating cash flow: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by average total assets
Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share: current minus 12 quarters ago divided by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg6.description: Six-month nominal change in 18-month alpha; alpha is the intercept from regressing monthly returns on the S&P 500 over the past 18 months
Percent change in mean consensus long-term growth forecast compared to six months ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chga.description: Six-month nominal change in 12-month alpha; alpha is the regression intercept of monthly returns versus the S&P 500
Six-month nominal change in 36-month alpha; alpha is the regression intercept of monthly returns versus the S&P 500 over 36 months
One-year change in accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales; current minus four quarters ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgc.description: One-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month cash flow; current minus four quarters ago scaled by average total assets
One-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month cash flow per share; current minus four quarters ago divided by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chge.description: One-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS (before extra items); current minus four quarters ago deflated by average assets per share
One-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS; current minus four quarters ago divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgf.description: One-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow; current minus four quarters ago divided by average total assets
One-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow per share; current minus four quarters ago divided by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgi.description: Change in inventory as a percentage of sales over one year; calculated as latest reported inventory/sales minus same ratio from four quarters ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgn.description: Year-over-year change in net operating assets to total assets; net operating assets = short-term debt + long-term debt + preferred equity + common equity - cash
Change in net profit margin over one year; calculated as latest quarterly net profit margin minus net profit margin from four quarters ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgo.description: Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow, asset-adjusted, over one year; calculated as the latest TTM operating cash flow minus TTM operating cash flow from four quarters ago, divided by average total assets
Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share over one year, divided by trading price

Change in operating liability leverage over one year; operating liability leverage = 1 - (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) / (total assets - cash); difference between current quarter and four quarters ago
Change in operating profit margin over one year; most recent quarterly operating profit margin minus operating profit margin from four quarters ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgr.description: Percent change in accounts receivable to current assets ratio over one year; most recent quarterly ratio minus ratio from same quarter one year ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgs.description: Difference between yearly change in quarterly SG&A expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales
Percent change in shares outstanding over one year; current vs. one year ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgv.description: Change in average trading volume over four years; difference in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover compared to the 12-month moving average four years ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cogs.description: Absolute difference between yearly percent change in trailing twelve-month cost of goods sold and yearly percent change in inventory level

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_covo.description: Sixty-month trading volume trend; slope of regression line of last 60 months' monthly trading volume against time

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curi.description: Stock's current book-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM dividend yield minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM EBITDA-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Trailing twelve-month EPS-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM free cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM operating cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM operating cash flow-to-total assets ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s TTM sales-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curr.description: Current assets divided by current liabilities from most recent quarter; a measure of liquidity

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cusi.description: Security identifier, typically CUSIP or SEDOL code used to uniquely identify a stock or financial instrument

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cvpr.description: Coefficient of variation of prior 90 days closing prices; last 90 days' price standard deviation divided by mean

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cvvo.description: Ratio of 20-day price volatility to 20-day volume volatility; coefficient of variation of closing prices divided by coefficient of variation of daily trading volume for last 20 days

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_de.description: Long-term debt divided by book equity from most recent quarter

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_debt.description: Sum of long-term debt and short-term interest-bearing debt divided by trailing twelve-month cash flow

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_dfl.description: Sum of trailing 12-month pretax income and interest expense divided by trailing 12-month pretax income

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_divc.description: Trailing 12-month cash dividends divided by trailing 12-month cash flow
Dividend Coverage Ratio: Company's trailing twelve-month profit from operations divided by its annual dividend payments

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_divy.description: TTM Dividend Yield: Trailing twelve-month dividends per share divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_dpca.description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs. CapEx: Absolute difference between yearly percent change in depreciation expense and that of capital expenditure over trailing twelve months

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ebit.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: Trailing twelve-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization divided by enterprise value (EV)
TTM EBITDA-to-Price: Trailing twelve-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_epsc.description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: Trailing twelve-month pre-tax income per share multiplied by the change in effective tax rate over the last four quarters

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_equi.description: Equity Turnover Ratio: Trailing twelve-month sales divided by average trailing twelve-month reported book equity

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_c.description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: Stock's next four quarters' consensus EPS-to-price ratio minus industry average and deflated by industry standard deviation
FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: Standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year one divided by mean consensus forecast
FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: Standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year two divided by mean consensus forecast

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_d.description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: Reciprocal of forward twelve-month price/earnings ratio divided by sum of forecasted long-term growth rate and indicated dividend yield

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_e.description: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson Value-to-Price: Firm's intrinsic valuation from EBO model divided by month-end trading price, comparing generated earnings to cost of capital
Inverse PEG Ratio: Next one year average forecasted earnings multiplied by long-term growth rate and scaled by stock price
Street Revision Magnitude: Three-month change in analysts' median forecast for fiscal year one scaled by current mean estimate
Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: Next fiscal year's median consensus earnings estimate divided by current trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_f.description: Forward 12-M EPS-to-Enterprise Value: Consensus forward twelve-month earnings per share forecast divided by sum of market value of equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share
Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: Next four quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing twelve-month depreciation minus capital expenditures, divided by trading price
Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow per share times next four quarters' consensus earnings forecast divided by book value per share, scaled by trading price
Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: Next four quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price
Forward Return on Equity: Analysts' earnings estimate for next four quarters divided by most recent reported common equity per share

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_h.description: Street Revision Confidence: Sum of three-month change in highest and lowest fiscal year one earnings estimates, scaled by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_n.description: Number of Analyst Coverage: Count of analysts making earnings estimates for fiscal year one
Net Number of Revisions for Fiscal Year One: Weighted average of analyst increases minus decreases in FY1 forecasts, divided by total analyst forecasts for the month

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_p.description: Predicted Dividend Yield: Assumed payout ratio times next four quarters' consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price; payout ratio blended from last year, consensus long-term growth rate, and base value

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_r.description: Five-Year Relative Leading 12-M Earnings Yield: Stock's current next four quarters' consensus earnings-to-price ratio minus five-year average, scaled by five-year standard deviation
Three-Month Revision in FY1 EPS Forecasts: Change in current mean consensus forecast for fiscal year one minus three months ago, deflated by trading price
Three-Month Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: Change in current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year two minus three months ago, deflated by trading price
Six-Month Average Revision for FY1 EPS: Average of prior six months' monthly changes in consensus analyst forecasts for fiscal year one, scaled by previous month-end price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_s.description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: Standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year one scaled by closing price
Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: Standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year two scaled by closing price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_y.description: Forecasted EPS growth for 2 years ahead: most recent consensus earnings estimate for year 2 minus year 1, divided by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fcfe.description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by average book equity over the same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fcfr.description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by average invested capital (sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, preferred stock) over the same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fcfs.description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ff10.description: Percent change in stock price from 12 months ago to 2 months ago (momentum)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fixa.description: Trailing 12-month sales divided by average total fixed assets for the same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_flow.description: (Current assets minus cash/equivalents) divided by (current liabilities minus short-term debt), using most recent quarter

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_gear.description: Long-term debt divided by (total assets minus current liabilities)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_high.description: Month-end price divided by highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_indr.description: Stock's lagged quarterly ROE minus industry average ROE, deflated by industry ROE standard deviation
Stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s 4-week return minus industry average 4-week return, deflated by industry standard deviation
Stock’s 5-day return minus industry average 5-day return, deflated by industry standard deviation

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_intc.description: Quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by quarterly long-term debt interest expenses

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_inva.description: Current inventory level divided by total assets from most recent quarter

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_invt.description: Trailing 12-month cost of goods sold divided by average inventory in the same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_lage.description: Trailing 12-month EPS before extraordinary items multiplied by change in yearly sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_liqc.description: Slope of regression between monthly stock trading turnover ratio and monthly stock price returns

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ltg.description: Consensus long-term growth forecast, typically expected annual operating earnings increase over next business cycle

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_mill.description: Monthly average of daily absolute return to daily dollar trading volume ratio (illiquidity measure)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_mktc.description: Current market capitalization divided by number of analysts providing Fiscal Year 1 EPS estimates

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_mktl.description: Total market value plus latest reported book debt divided by market value

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_navp.description: Book value of net assets per share minus intangibles and liabilities, divided by closing price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ncfe.description: Absolute difference between yearly percent change in operating cash flow per share and yearly percent change in diluted EPS before extraordinary items, TTM

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_netc.description: Quarterly cash & equivalents minus long- and short-term debt, divided by current market value

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_netd.description: Net debt (long- plus short-term debt minus cash & equivalents) divided by the sum of net debt, preferred stock, and common stock (quarterly)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nfal.description: Quarterly reported net fixed assets divided by long-term debt

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nipe.description: Net income after taxes for trailing 12 months divided by number of employees at last fiscal year end

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nlas.description: Natural logarithm of most recent quarterly reported total assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nlmk.description: Natural logarithm of the cubic of stock’s total market value

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nlpr.description: Natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's unadjusted closing price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nlsa.description: Natural logarithm of the cubic of a company's trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nlvo.description: Natural logarithm of the ratio of trailing 1-year average monthly volume to trailing 1-year average monthly market value of shares outstanding

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nnas.description: Net current assets per share minus total liabilities per share, divided by price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_noat.description: Trailing 12-month sales divided by 4-quarter average net operating assets (net operating assets = short-term debt + long-term debt + preferred equity + common equity - cash)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_nopa.description: Trailing 12-month NOPAT margin: (Net Income + Interest Expense × (1-Effective Tax Rate)) divided by Net Sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_npm.description: Most recently reported quarterly net income after tax divided by quarterly sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ocfa.description: Trailing 12-month net cash flow from operations divided by average total assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ocfm.description: Trailing 12-month cash flow from operations divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ocfr.description: Most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations divided by current liabilities
Trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by average invested capital (invested capital = common equity + long-term debt + minority interest + preferred stock) for the period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_olle.description: 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash) for the current quarter

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_opin.description: Difference between yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ople.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month operating income (from previous quarter) divided by percent change in trailing 12-month sales (from previous quarter)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_opmb.description: Most recently reported quarterly operating income divided by quarterly sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_p50_.description: Moving average of last 50 days stock prices divided by moving average of last 200 days stock prices

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_past.description: Month-end trading price divided by most recent quarterly reported total assets per share

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_pcta.description: Current closing price divided by lowest daily low price in last 260 trading days

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_pctc.description: Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share compared to 12 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share compared to 12 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share compared to 12 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share compared to 12 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent asset turnover ratio compared to 4 quarters ago; asset turnover ratio = trailing 12-month sales / average total assets
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items compared to 4 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago
Percent change in most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago
Growth in most recent reported quarterly total assets per share compared to four quarters ago
Growth in most recent reported quarterly sales per share compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_pcur.description: Most recently reported quarterly current liabilities per share divided by closing price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_perg.description: Risk-adjusted PEG Ratio: Stock price divided by forward 12-month consensus earnings, scaled by average long-term growth estimate, and multiplied by 36-month beta

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_pino.description: Pretax Return on Net Operating Assets: Trailing 12-month operating income after depreciation divided by average net operating assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_pr_1.description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: Moving average of last 15 weeks' prices divided by moving average of last 36 weeks' prices

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_pr_3.description: 30-75 Week Stock Price Ratio: Moving average of last 30 weeks' prices divided by moving average of last 75 weeks' prices

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_qr.description: Quick Ratio: (Current assets minus inventories) divided by total current liabilities from the most recent quarter

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rati.description: Rational Decay Alpha: Historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return using proprietary decay function (Y-intercept from OLS regression)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ratr.description: Street Rating Revision: 6-month average change in analyst recommendations

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rdsa.description: R&D Intensity: Average trailing 12-month R&D expenses divided by total sales in the same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rein.description: Reinvestment Rate: (TTM earnings per share before extra items minus TTM dividends per share) divided by average book equity per share

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rel5.description: 5-year Relative Book-to-Market: Current book-to-market ratio minus 60-month average BTM, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: Current TTM cash flow-to-price ratio minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM Dividend Yield: Current dividend yield minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: Current TTM EBITDA per share-to-price minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM Earnings-to-Price: Current TTM EPS before extra items-to-price ratio minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: Current TTM free cash flow-to-price minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: Current TTM operating cash flow-to-price minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation
5-year Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: Current TTM sales-to-price ratio minus 60-month average, scaled by 60-month standard deviation

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_relp.description: Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: Stock's 12-month price strength minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_reoa.description: Retained Earnings-to-Total Assets: Cumulative retained earnings from most recent quarter divided by total assets in same quarter

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rerr.description: Regression Error of 60-Month CAPM: Standard error of regression slope for stock's last 60-month returns against S&P 500 returns

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_revp.description: Revenue per Employee: Trailing 12-month total sales divided by number of employees at last reported fiscal year end

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_roa.description: Return on Assets: TTM income before extra items divided by average total assets in same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_roe.description: Return on Equity: TTM income before extra items divided by average common equity in same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_roic.description: Return on Invested Capital: TTM net income plus interest expenses divided by average invested capital (common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, preferred stock)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rsi2.description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength: Most recent weekly closing price divided by weekly closing price 26 weeks ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rtn2.description: Second Preceding 6-month Return: Percent price change from month t-12 to t-7

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_rtn3.description: 39-Week Return with 4-week Lag: Price change from week t-43 to week t-4

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_sale.description: Change in TTM Sales vs EPS: Absolute value of difference between yearly percent change in TTM sales per share and TTM diluted EPS percent change
5-year Sales Growth: Difference between TTM sales per share and those 20 quarters ago, deflated by average prior 20 quarters' sales per share
Change in Quarterly Sales vs Gross Margin: Difference between yearly change in most recent reported quarterly sales and yearly change in quarterly gross profit margin
Difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_sga.description: Trailing 12-month selling, general and administrative expenses divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_sigm.description: Standard deviation of a stock’s monthly returns over the prior 60 months

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_skew.description: Skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily excess returns (relative to S&P 500) over the last 90 days, using 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation
Skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily price returns over the last 90 days, measuring lack of symmetry, calculated as 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_slop.description: 4-week lagged slope coefficient from least squares regression of last 52 weeks’ weekly closing price against weekly dates
4-week lagged slope coefficient from least squares regression of last 66 weeks’ weekly closing price against weekly dates

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_stoc.description: Consensus recommendation for a company (“Street Consensus Rating”)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_surp.description: Difference between actual earnings per share and consensus forecasts prior to announcement, scaled by quarter-end price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_susg.description: Maximum growth rate a firm can sustain without increasing financial leverage

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_swc.description: Average working capital over trailing 12 months divided by total sales in that period; working capital = inventory + accounts receivable - accounts payable

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_tobi.description: Market value of equity plus debt, divided by assets; (E+D)/A, with debt measured at book value

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_tota.description: (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid) divided by (Interest + Principal Paid)
Percent change in company’s trailing 12-month total sales versus total sales one year ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_tsta.description: (CORREL*(260-2)^.5)/(1-CORREL^2)^.5, where CORREL is the correlation coefficient between log daily stock price and dates over the last 260 days (1-year price momentum indicator)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttma.description: Difference between trailing 12-month net income and trailing 12-month operating cash flow, scaled by beginning total assets (accounting accruals)

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttmc.description: Trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share divided by trading price
Trailing 12-month cash flow per share (net income plus depreciation) scaled by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttme.description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.
The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account of non-recurring gain or loss.stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttmf.description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow for a stock divided by its enterprise value (EV = equity market value + long/short-term debt + preferred stock + minority interest - cash)
Trailing 12-month free cash flow per share divided by month-end price; FCF = operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttmg.description: Sum of trailing 12-month growth flow value per share (R&D expenses plus reported net income) divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttmo.description: Trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share divided by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttmp.description: Most recent trailing 12-month operating and non-operating income per share before income taxes and minority interest for a stock, deflated by trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ttms.description: Trailing 12-month sales for a stock divided by most recent enterprise value
Most recently reported trailing 12-month sales per share divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_tw_e.description: Twelve-month forward earnings yield using time-weighted combination of FY1 and FY2 earnings estimates

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_uap.description: Difference between current accounts payable and expected accounts payable (prior year closing balance grown by trailing 12-month cost of goods sold), scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_uar.description: Difference between current accounts receivable and expected accounts receivable (prior year closing balance grown by trailing 12-month sales), scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_udep.description: Unexpected Change in Depreciation: the difference between trailing 12-month depreciation expense and the expected level (derived from prior-year closing fixed asset balance and fixed asset growth), scaled by total assets

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_uinv.description: Unexpected Change in Inventory: the difference between a company’s actual inventory level and its expected inventory level, derived from forecasts or historical trends

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_var2.description: 24-Month Value at Risk: the minimum monthly price return over the last 20 months, representing the extreme negative return in that period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_varr.description: 24-month residual return variance: the variance of monthly residual returns over the last 24 months, where residual return equals the stock’s monthly return minus 60-month Beta times the S&P 500 monthly return

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_visi.description: Visibility Ratio: most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume over the previous 50 trading days

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_volp.description: 6-month moving average of the monthly trading turnover ratio, representing average trading activity over the last 6 months

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_volt.description: Trading Turnover Ratio: monthly total trading volume divided by the most recently reported total outstanding shares

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_wcac.description: Working Capital Accruals: accrual component of earnings based on changes such as increases in accounts receivable and inventory and decreases in accounts payable, accrued liabilities, and income taxes, adjusted for asset and liability changes

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_wcas.description: Working Capital-to-Total Assets: average working capital over the trailing 12 months divided by average total assets over the same period

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_wcin.description: Working Capital to Inventory: most recent quarterly working capital divided by inventory, indicating liquidity coverage of stock levels

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_yoyc.description: Year-over-year change in accruals-to-assets: the difference between scaled accruals (income before extraordinary items minus operating cash flow, divided by average assets) this period and the same quarter a year ago
Year-over-year change in current ratio: the change in current assets divided by current liabilities from the most recent quarter versus the same quarter a year ago
Year-over-year change in leverage: the change in total liabilities as a percentage of total assets from the most recent quarter versus the same quarter a year ago
Year-over-year change in gross profit margin: the change in (sales minus cost of goods sold) divided by sales from the most recent quarter versus the same quarter a year ago
Year-over-year change in return on assets: the change in trailing 12-month income before extraordinary items as a percentage of total assets versus the same quarter a year ago

mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamericasensitivit.description: Company sales exposure or proportion of total sales attributable to Asia-Pacific region
Cash Earnings Return On Equity, a measure of profitability calculated as cash earnings divided by equity
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in Credit Risk Premium (spread between BAA and AAA bonds)
Debt to Assets ratio, measures leverage as total debt divided by total assets
Company sales exposure or proportion of total sales attributable to Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in Housing Starts
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in the inflation rate
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in industrial production
Company sales exposure or proportion of total sales attributable to Latin America region
Company sales exposure or proportion of total sales attributable to North America region
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in oil prices
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in US Dollar value
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in overall market volatility as measured by the VIX index
Sensitivity or beta/exposure of the company's returns or fundamentals to changes in the yield curve slope

mdl177_2_growthanalystmodel_qga_composit.description: Composite score combining multiple Growth Analyst signals into a single metric

mdl177_2_growthanalystmodel_qga_epstrend.description: Trend indicator for earnings per share (direction and persistence of recent EPS changes)

mdl177_2_growthanalystmodel_qga_fcfroe.description: Return on equity computed using free cash flow (Free Cash Flow / Shareholders' Equity)

mdl177_2_growthanalystmodel_qga_iarsales.description: Inv Acc Rec to Sales Link

mdl177_2_growthanalystmodel_qga_niroe.description: Return on equity computed using net income (Net Income / Shareholders' Equity)

mdl177_2_growthanalystmodel_qga_opmargin.description: Measure of linkage between operating margin and sales (strength of margins relative to revenue growth)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3ycfa.description: Absolute change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow over three years, scaled by average total assets

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3ycfp.description: Change in trailing 12-month cash flow per share over 3 years divided by trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yeps.description: Change in trailing 12-month EPS (before extra items) from 12 quarters ago, divided by average total assets per share
Change in trailing twelve-month earnings per share from 12 quarters ago, divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yfcf.description: Absolute change in trailing twelve-month free cash flow over three years, scaled by average total assets
Change in trailing 12-month free cash flow per share over 3 years, divided by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yocf.description: Change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow from 12 quarters ago, divided by average total assets
Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share from 12 quarters ago, divided by trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgars.description: Change in accounts receivable to sales ratio over the past year (quarterly)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgcf.description: Change in trailing twelve-month cash flow over the past year (four quarters), scaled by average total assets

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgcfp.description: Change in trailing 12-month cash flow per share over the past year divided by trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgeps.description: Change in trailing twelve-month earnings per share (before extra items) from 4 quarters ago, scaled by average total assets per share

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgepsp.description: Change in trailing 12-month earnings per share over the past year, scaled by month-end trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgfcf.description: Change in trailing 12-month free cash flow over the past year divided by average total assets

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgfcfp.description: Change in trailing 12-month free cash flow per share over the past year divided by trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgis.description: Change in the ratio of inventory to sales over the past year (quarterly)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgnpm.description: Change in net profit margin from one year ago (quarterly), calculated as the difference between most recent and year-ago net profit margin

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgocf.description: Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow from 4 quarters ago, divided by average total assets

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgocfp.description: Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share from 4 quarters ago, divided by the trading price

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_chgopm.description: Change in quarterly operating profit margin over the past year

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qcf3y.description: Coefficient of variation (stability or volatility) of trailing twelve-month cash flow over the past 3 years

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qeps3.description: Coefficient of variation (a measure of stability or volatility) of trailing twelve-month earnings per share over a 3-year period

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qfcf3.description: Coefficient of variation (stability or volatility) of trailing twelve-month free cash flow over a 3-year period

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qocf3.description: Coefficient of variation (stability or volatility) of trailing twelve-month operating cash flow over a 3-year period

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qsale.description: Coefficient of variation (stability or volatility) of trailing twelve-month sales over a 3-year period

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_cvopinc.description: Coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean) of operating income per share during last 12 quarters

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_fcfequit.description: TTM free cash flow divided by average book equity in the same 12-month period

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3y.description: Percent change in trailing twelve-month cash flow per share over a 3-year period
Percent change in trailing 12-month earnings per share compared to 12 quarters ago
Percent change in trailing twelve-month free cash flow per share over a 3-year period
Percent change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share over a 3-year (12-quarter) period

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgas.description: Percent change in asset turnover ratio over the past year (TTM sales divided by average total assets compared to 4 quarters ago)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgcf.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgep.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month EPS before extra items compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgfc.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month free cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgoc.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqt.description: Percent change in most recent reported quarterly total assets per share compared to four quarters ago
Growth in most recent quarterly sales per share compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_reinrate.description: Reinvestment rate: trailing 12-month EPS before extra items minus dividends per share, divided by average book equity per share

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qcf.description: R-squared of the regression trend line for trailing twelve-month cash flow per share over the prior 12 quarters (3 years)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qep.description: R-squared of the 3-year trend line for TTM EPS (regression fit quality)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qfc.description: R-squared of the 3-year trend line for TTM free cash flow (regression fit quality)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qoc.description: R-squared of the 3-year trend line for TTM operating cash flow (regression fit quality)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qsa.description: R-squared of the regression trend line for trailing twelve-month sales per share over the prior 12 quarters (3 years)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_saleg5y.description: 5-year growth in sales per share, difference from 20 quarters ago, deflated by average sales in the prior 20 quarters

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_salegstd.description: Standard deviation of year-over-year quarterly sales growth rate during last 12 quarters

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_salesacc.description: Measure of acceleration in quarterly sales growth over the last 4 quarters

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_se5yepsg.description: Mean long-term EPS growth rate minus 5-year EPS growth, divided by the stability (variation) of 5-year EPS growth

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qc.description: Slope of the 3-year trend line for quarterly cash flow (using 4-quarter data)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qe.description: Slope of trend line for TTM EPS over the past 3 years (using 4-quarter data)

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qf.description: Slope of the 3-year trend line for trailing twelve-month free cash flow per share, indicating long-term growth rate

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qo.description: Slope of the 3-year trend line for trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share, indicating long-term growth rate

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qs.description: Slope of the 3-year trend line for trailing twelve-month sales per share, indicating long-term growth rate

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_susgrowt.description: Maximum sustainable growth rate for the firm without increasing leverage

mdl177_2_historicalgrowthfactor_totalsal.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month total sales compared to one year ago

mdl177_2_industryrrelativevaluefactor_cu.description: Industry Relative Book-to-Market: Stock's current book-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month core earnings-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Dividend Yield: Stock's trailing 12-month dividend yield minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM EPS-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: Stock's next 4-quarter analyst EPS estimate-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Total Assets: Stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-total assets ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation
Industry Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: Stock's trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_altmanz.description: Altman Z score; linear combination of five financial ratios to evaluate bankruptcy risk

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_aqi.description: Asset Quality Index; year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of (current assets + property, plant & equipment) divided by total assets

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_astcomp.description: Asset composition; current assets from most recent quarter divided by total assets from same quarter

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_atmcallvol.description: Implied volatility of the company’s nearest at-the-money call options

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_atmputvol.description: Implied volatility of nearest at-the-money put options for the company

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_bap20d.description: 20-day average of bid-ask spread divided by price, proxy for short-term liquidity

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_bdi.description: Number of days company can pay its daily operating expenses using only cash and receivables, i.e. basic defensive interval

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_beta.description: 60-month beta coefficient: 0.67 times 60-month beta plus 0.33, measuring stock sensitivity to market (S&P 500) movements over past 5 years

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_betasigma.description: Product of 60-month market beta and standard deviation of monthly returns, indicating combined systematic and total risk

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_booklev.description: Book leverage ratio; reported quarterly total assets divided by book equity

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_cashratio.description: Most recent quarter’s cash and equivalents divided by current liabilities, indicating liquidity position

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_ccd.description: Current cash flow debt coverage ratio: most recent quarterly cash flow from operations less cash dividends, divided by interest-bearing debt

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_cfleverage.description: Cash flow leverage; total liabilities divided by trailing 12-month operating cash flow

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_covol.description: Slope of the regression line across 60 months of trading volume against time; indicates trend in trading activity

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_curratio.description: Current ratio; most recent quarter’s current assets divided by current liabilities

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_cvvolp20d.description: Ratio of coefficient of variation of last 20 days’ closing prices to coefficient of variation of daily trading volume for same period; a liquidity or volatility indicator

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_de.description: Long-term debt-to-equity; latest long-term debt divided by book equity

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_debtcf.description: Sum of latest reported long-term debt and short-term interest-bearing debt divided by TTM cash flow

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_dfl.description: Degree of financial leverage; sum of TTM pretax income and TTM interest expense divided by TTM pretax income

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_divcov.description: Ratio of trailing 1-year profits to annual dividends, representing coverage of dividends by earnings

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_flowratio.description: Flow ratio; (current assets minus cash & equivalents) divided by (current liabilities minus short-term debt), using latest quarterly data

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_gear.description: Capital gearing ratio; long-term debt divided by (total assets minus current liabilities)

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_intcov.description: Interest coverage; latest quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by long-term debt interest expenses

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_liqcoeff.description: Liquidity coefficient; slope from regression between monthly trading turnover ratio and monthly price returns

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmni.description: Three-year mean absolute deviation of trailing twelve month net income, measuring income variability over the past three years

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmsal.description: Three-year mean absolute deviation of trailing twelve month sales, measuring revenue variability over three years

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_milliq.description: Stock illiquidity; monthly average of daily absolute return divided by daily dollar trading volume

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_mktcappera.description: Current market capitalization divided by the number of analysts providing fiscal year 1 earnings estimates

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_mktlev.description: Sum of total market capitalization and most recent quarterly book debt divided by market capitalization; represents market leverage

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_monchgsip.description: Month-to-month change in short interest position (ratio), measures change in the amount of stock sold short

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_netcashp.description: Net cash to equity; (quarterly cash & equivalents minus long-term and current debt) divided by current market value

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_nfaldebt.description: Most recent quarterly net fixed assets divided by total long-term debt; gauges asset coverage of long-term debt

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_nlassets.description: Natural logarithm of most recent quarterly total assets

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_nlmktcap.description: Natural logarithm of the cube of a company’s total market capitalization, as a size factor

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_nlprice.description: Natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's unadjusted closing price

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_nlsales.description: Natural logarithm of the cube of a company’s trailing twelve-month sales, used as a size proxy

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_nlvolcap.description: Logarithm of the ratio of trailing one-year average monthly trading volume to trailing one-year average monthly market capitalization, assessing liquidity

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_numest.description: Number of financial analysts providing earnings estimates for the company for the current fiscal year

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_ocfratio.description: Operating cash flow ratio; latest quarterly operating cash flow divided by current liabilities

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_ohlsonscore.description: Ohlson bankruptcy score; statistical model assessing bankruptcy probability based on size, leverage, performance, liquidity

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_oplev.description: Operating leverage; percent change in TTM operating income from previous quarter divided by percent change in TTM sales from previous quarter

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_pcurlia.description: Current liabilities per share (from latest report) divided by the company’s closing share price, indicating balance sheet risk relative to equity value

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_qr.description: Quick ratio: (current assets minus inventories) divided by current liabilities for most recent quarter, measures short-term financial strength

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_rerror60m.description: Standard error of the slope of the regression line relating 60 months of a stock’s monthly returns to S&P 500 Index returns; a measure of CAPM model fit risk

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_si_ratio.description: Ratio of shares sold short to average daily trading volume over the last 30 days

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_sigma.description: Standard deviation of a stock’s monthly returns over prior 60 months; a volatility measure

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_sip.description: Total shares of the company sold short, as reported by the exchange

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_tobinq.description: Tobin’s q ratio; market value of equity plus debt divided by total assets, debt measured at book value

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_totalcov.description: Ratio of (cash flow from operations + interest paid + tax paid) to (interest and principal paid); assesses ability to cover debt service

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_voldiff_pc.description: Implied volatility difference between at-the-money put and call options, capturing liquidity risk or sentiment skew

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_volto.description: Trading turnover ratio; monthly total trading volume divided by current outstanding shares

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_yoychgcr.description: Year-over-year change in current ratio, comparing the most recent quarterly current ratio to that of the same quarter one year ago

mdl177_2_liquidityriskfactor_yoychgda.description: Year-over-year quarterly change in leverage, expressed as difference in total liabilities to total assets percentage from a year ago to current
