mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_aci.description: Abnormal Capital Investment: change in firm’s recent trailing 12-month capital investment intensity compared to the average of prior 3-year investment intensity

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_acp.description: Average collection period: average trailing 12-month accounts receivable times 365 divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_app.description: Average payable period: average trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by trailing 12-month cost of goods sold

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_aspanra.description: Quarterly operating assets minus operating liabilities, divided by lagged total assets

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_astto.description: Assets Turnover Ratio: trailing 12-month sales divided by most recently reported quarterly assets

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_capacq.description: Capital acquisition ratio, a measure relevant to sector or industry valuation and financial health

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_capexas.description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by total assets from most recent quarter

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_capexsa.description: Capital expenditures divided by sales over the trailing 12 months

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_cashbur.description: Negative of (cash from operations + cash from investments) divided by (cash + short-term investments)

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_cashc.description: Cash cycle: average inventory days plus average collection days minus average payable days

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_cashsal.description: Cash-to-sales: average cash & equivalents in trailing 12 months divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_cfita.description: TTM Cash Flow from Investment to Total Assets: trailing 12-month cash flow from investing divided by last 4 quarters’ average total assets

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_cfroi.description: Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: trailing 12-month cash flow divided by average invested capital (common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock)

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_chgnoa.description: Year-over-year change of net operating assets to total assets, where net operating assets equal short-term debt plus long-term debt plus preferred equity plus common equity minus cash

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_chgolle.description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: current quarter operating liability leverage less operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_chgrecc.description: Year-over-year change in accounts receivable to current assets

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_divcf.description: Dividends to cash flow: trailing 12-month cash dividends divided by trailing 12-month cash flow

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_equityt.description: Equity Turnover: trailing 12-month sales divided by average trailing 12-month reported book equity

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_fcfroi.description: Free Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by average invested capital

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_fcfsale.description: Free cash flow to sales ratio over the trailing 12 months

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_fixastt.description: Fixed Assets Turnover: trailing 12-month sales divided by average total fixed assets over the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_indrelc.description: Stock’s lagged quarterly return on equity minus the industry average ROE, normalized by industry ROE standard deviation

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_invast.description: Current inventory level divided by total assets from most recent quarter

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_invto.description: Inventory Turnover Ratio: trailing 12-month cost of goods sold divided by average inventory over the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_min1ygr.description: Lowest gross margin over the last 1 year

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_min1yop.description: Minimum (trough) operating margin in the last year

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_min2ygr.description: Lowest gross margin over the last 2 years

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_min2yop.description: Minimum (trough) operating margin in the last 2 years

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_min3ygr.description: Lowest gross margin over the last 3 years

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_min3yop.description: Lowest operating profit margin over the last 3 years

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_netdebt.description: Net Debt Ratio: net debt divided by sum of net debt, preferred stock, and common stock, with net debt as long-term plus short-term debt minus cash & equivalents (most recent quarter)

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_niper.description: Net income per employee: income after taxes for trailing 12 months divided by number of employees at last reported fiscal year end

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_noato.description: Net operating asset turnover: trailing 12-month sales divided by 4-quarters average net operating assets (short-term debt + long-term debt + preferred equity + common equity - cash)

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_nopatma.description: Net operating profit after tax (NOPAT) margin: (Net Income + Interest Expense*(1-Effective Tax Rate)) divided by net sales, all for trailing 12 months

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_npm.description: Net profit margin: most recent quarterly net income after tax divided by corresponding quarterly sales

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_ocfast.description: Operating cash flow to assets: trailing 12-month net cash flow from operations divided by average total assets

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_ocfmarg.description: Operating Cash Flow Profit Margin: trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_ocfroi.description: Operating cash flow return on invested capital: trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by average invested capital over same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_ollev.description: Operating liability leverage: 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash) in the current quarter

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_opmb.description: Operating Profit Margin: quarterly operating income divided by quarterly sales

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_pinoa.description: Pretax return on net operating assets: trailing 12-month operating income after depreciation divided by average net operating assets

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_rdsale.description: R&D intensity: average trailing 12-month research & development expenses divided by total sales in the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_reoa.description: Retained Earnings-to-Total Assets: cumulative retained earnings from most recent quarter divided by total assets from same quarter

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_revper.description: Total sales for the trailing 12 months divided by number of employees at last fiscal year end

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_roa.description: Return on assets: trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by average total assets in the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_roe.description: Return on equity: trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by average common equity in the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_roic.description: Return on Invested Capital: trailing 12-month net income and interest expenses divided by average invested capital (common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock)

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_saleica.description: Trailing 12-month sales divided by invested capital

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_sga.description: SG&A Expenses-to-Sales: trailing 12-month selling, general & admin expenses divided by trailing 12-month sales

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_swc.description: Working capital to sales: average working capital for trailing 12 months divided by total sales in the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_wcast.description: Working Capital-to-Total Assets: average working capital in the trailing 12-months divided by average total assets in the same period

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_wcinv.description: Working Capital to Inventory: most recent quarterly working capital divided by inventory

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_yoychgg.description: Yearly Change In Gross Profit Margin: most recent quarterly gross profit margin minus margin for same quarter one year ago

mdl177_2_managementqualityfactor_yoychgr.description: Yearly Change in Return on Assets: most recent trailing 12-month net income before extra items as % of total assets, minus % for same quarter one year ago

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_alpha6.description: Rank of the six-month change in alpha (risk-adjusted outperformance) relative to peers

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_chgnow.description: Rank of change in net working capital (current assets minus current liabilities), indicating how working capital shifts relative to peers

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_compos.description: Rank representing composite momentum signal derived from analyst-related factors

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_condsu.description: Rank of the conditional earnings or revenue surprise, likely adjusted for market or analyst expectations

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_earnex.description: Rank for analyst expectations, calculated as equal-weighted average of earnings revisions and ratings change ranks

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_eplink.description: Rank indicating the strength of linkage between earnings-related changes and stock price movement, considering factors like free cash flow and market reaction

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_epsgrw.description: Rank representing change in trailing twelve month EPS growth, scaled by recent stock price (earnings yield based)

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_estrev.description: Rank based on analyst estimate revisions, reflecting recent up and down changes to future EPS forecasts relative to total estimates

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_indrel.description: Rank based on difference between a stock’s 3-month return and the industry average 3-month return

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_lagpri.description: Rank of lagged price momentum, comparing prior 12-month to recent 1-month returns and adjusting for volatility

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_mktres.description: Rank based on the market's price response following recent earnings announcements, typically measured over a short window

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_rating.description: Rank reflecting analyst ratings changes, indicating the trend in upgrades and downgrades over recent months

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_relpri.description: Rank of the stock's price momentum relative to market or peer group, combining various momentum measures

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_repear.description: Rank representing average of earnings growth and earnings surprise, measuring earnings momentum

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_rskadj.description: Rank aggregating risk adjustments, incorporating volatility and growth, penalizing excessive volatility or return deviations

mdl177_2_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_ttmfcf.description: Rank for change in trailing twelve month free cash flow over two quarters, scaled by previous value

mdl177_2_priceanalystmodel2_qpa_composit.description: Composite signal from the QSG Price Analyst model for US equities, combining multiple analyst-driven price-related factors into a single score

mdl177_2_priceanalystmodel_qpa_compsn.description: Sector-neutral price analyst model signal, designed to remove sector biases from the stock’s price signal

mdl177_2_priceanalystmodel_qpa_indrs.description: Industry relative strength signal for a stock, measuring its price performance versus its industry peers

mdl177_2_pricemomemtummodel2_indrelrtn5d.description: 5-day industry-relative return: the stock’s 5-day return minus its industry average, standardized by the industry’s return standard deviation; captures recent momentum relative to peers

mdl177_2_pricemomemtummodel_pmm_composit.description: A combined price momentum signal aggregating multiple price momentum metrics for a stock, used as an overall momentum indicator

mdl177_2_pricemomemtummodel_rationalalph.description: The excess 12-month return of a stock versus the market (S&P 500), adjusted using a proprietary rational decay function based on the Y-intercept of an OLS regression

mdl177_2_pricemomemtummodel_relpricestre.description: The stock's industry-adjusted 12-month relative price strength: its 12-month price strength minus the average price strength of stocks in the same industry, normalized by industry standard deviation

mdl177_2_pricemomemtummodel_visiratio.description: Ratio of a stock's latest daily trading volume to its average daily trading volume over the previous 50 days, reflecting recent activity versus typical volume

mdl177_2_pricemomemtummodel_voldiff_pc.description: Difference between at-the-money put option volatility and at-the-money call option volatility for the stock, measuring put-call implied volatility skew

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_abr.description: Abnormal return observed around the quarterly earnings release event for the stock

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn12m.description: Percent change in stock price from 13 months ago to 1 month ago (12-month active return with 1-month lag)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn18m.description: Percent change in stock price from 19 months ago to 1 month ago (18-month active return with 1-month lag)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn1m.description: Percent change in stock price from last month to this month (1-month active return)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn24m.description: Percent change in stock price from 25 months ago to 1 month ago (24-month active return with 1-month lag)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn2m.description: Percent change in the stock's price over the last 2 months

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn36m.description: Percent price change for the stock from 37 months prior to 1 month prior; a measure of 36-month active return

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn3m.description: Percent change in price over the last three months

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn60m.description: Percent change in stock price from 61 months ago to 1 month ago (60-month active return with 1-month lag)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn6m.description: Percent price change for the stock from 7 months prior to 1 month prior; a measure of 6-month active return

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_alpha60m.description: Intercept from regression of stock's monthly returns against S&P 500 monthly returns over last 60 months (five-year alpha)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_chg6malpha1.description: Change in stock's 18-month alpha over previous 6 months; alpha is regression intercept (monthly returns vs S&P 500) over last 18 months

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha12m.description: Change in the stock's 12-month alpha over the last 6 months, where alpha is the regression intercept of the stock's monthly returns against the S&P 500 returns over the past 12 months

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha36m.description: Change in stock's 36-month alpha over the past 6 months, where alpha is regression intercept (monthly returns vs S&P 500) over 36-month period

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_chgvolpre4y.description: Difference between recent 6-month average monthly trading volume (as turnover ratio) and the 12-month average monthly turnover ratio from 4 years ago, measuring volume trends and changes in liquidity

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_cvpre90dp.description: Coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean) of the stock's closing prices over the last 90 days, reflecting price volatility relative to mean

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_ff10mrtn.description: Percent price change representing Fama-French momentum from 12 months prior to 2 months prior for the stock

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_high52w.description: Ratio of the stock's month-end price to the highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months, measuring proximity to 52-week high

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn4w.description: Stock's 4-week return minus industry average 4-week return, scaled by industry standard deviation, indicating industry-relative momentum over one month

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn5d.description: Stock's 5-day return minus industry average 5-day return, scaled by industry standard deviation, reflecting industry-relative momentum

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_normalmf60d.description: Money Flow signal normalized over the last 60 days

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_p50_200rati.description: Moving average of a stock's last 50 days prices divided by the moving average over the last 200 days; a technical indicator for intermediate/long-term price trends

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_pc_ratio.description: Put/Call ratio (ratio of traded put options to call options), an indicator of market sentiment or positioning

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_pctabv260lo.description: Ratio of the current closing price to the lowest daily price in the last 260 trading days, measuring how far price has risen above long-term low

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_po4_52.description: Difference or oscillator between the stock's price measured over a 4-week versus 52-week period, typically used to gauge intermediate-term momentum

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_pr_1536.description: Ratio of moving average of the stock's prices in the last 15 weeks to the moving average in the last 36 weeks, indicating price momentum over short/medium terms

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_pr_30w75w.description: Moving average of last 30 weeks' prices divided by moving average of last 75 weeks' prices, indicating medium/long-term trend

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_pvt51w.description: 51-week volume price trend indicator with a 4-week lag

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_rationalalp.description: Proprietary measure of the stock's 12-month market-adjusted excess return (regression Y-intercept vs S&P 500) adjusted by a rational decay process

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_relpricestr.description: Industry-adjusted 12-month relative price strength; stock's price strength relative to industry peers, standardized

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_rsi26w.description: Ratio of most recent weekly closing price to the closing price 26 weeks ago; a 26-week relative price strength indicator

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_rtn2nd6m.description: Percent price change from 12 months ago to 7 months ago (second preceding 6-month return), measuring earlier momentum

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_rtn39w.description: Stock price change over a 39-week period with a 4-week lag (from week t-43 to t-4)

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_sharpe36m.description: Sharpe Ratio for the past 36 months, which quantifies risk-adjusted return using total volatility

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn.description: Skewness of daily stock excess returns (vs. S&P 500 index) over the previous 90 days

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn.description: Skewness (asymmetry) of the distribution of daily stock returns over the most recent 90 days

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_slope52wp.description: Lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of weekly closing prices over the last 52 weeks

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_slope66wp.description: Lagged slope coefficient from least squares regression of closing prices over the last 66 weeks, indicating the trend and strength of price movement

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_sortinorati.description: Sortino Ratio, which measures risk-adjusted return considering only downside (negative) volatility

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_tstalp.description: One-year price momentum indicator based on the correlation of log daily prices over the last 260 trading days

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_var24m.description: Minimum monthly price return for a stock over the last 24 months, used as a Value at Risk measure

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_varresirtn.description: Variance of the monthly residual return (actual minus beta-adjusted S&P 500 return) over the last 24 months, measuring idiosyncratic volatility

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_visiratio.description: Stock's most recent daily volume divided by the average daily volume over prior 50 trading days, indicating current volume visibility or liquidity spike

mdl177_2_pricemomentumfactor_volpre6m.description: 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio (trading volume relative to shares outstanding)

mdl177_2_put_put_chshrs.description: Percent change in shares outstanding over a recent period, e.g. due to buybacks or issuance

mdl177_2_put_put_indepsp.description: Industry-relative ratio of core EPS to price

mdl177_2_put_put_indestep.description: Industry-relative ratio of expected (forward-looking, aggregate next 4 quarters) earnings per share to price

mdl177_2_put_put_indfcfp.description: Industry-relative ratio of free cash flow to price

mdl177_2_put_put_momod.description: Composite momentum module, combining multiple momentum signals

mdl177_2_put_put_opincev.description: Ratio of operating income to enterprise value

mdl177_2_put_put_siratio.description: Short-interest ratio (shares sold short divided by float or average daily volume)

mdl177_2_put_put_sucf.description: Standardized value of unexpected cash flow (actual minus expected, normalized across stocks)

mdl177_2_relativevaluemodel_capacq.description: Capital Acquisition Ratio; trailing 12-month operating cash flow less cash dividends, divided by total expenditures for the same period

mdl177_2_relativevaluemodel_fc_estep.description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield; median consensus earnings estimate for the next fiscal year divided by trading price

mdl177_2_relativevaluemodel_roe.description: Return on Equity; trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by average common equity for the same period

mdl177_2_relativevaluemodel_rvm_composit.description: Relative Value Model Composite; overall composite score aggregating various relative value signals within the model

mdl177_2_relativevaluemodel_ttmfcfp.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price; trailing 12-month free cash flow per share divided by month-end trading price. Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_actrtn9m.description: Percent change in the stock price over the past 9 months, with a 1-month lag (from month t-10 to t-1)

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_apsales.description: Company’s sales revenue exposure to the Asia-Pacific region, expressed as a proportion of total sales

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_capexdepli.description: Capital Expenditures to Depreciation Linkage : It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between ranked (1-1000) quarterly capital expenditures to assets and ranked (1-1000) quarterly depreciation to assets.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_chg12msip.description: Change in the short interest ratio (shares sold short / shares outstanding) over the previous 12 months

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_chg12mtotd.description: Relative change in total debt (sum of long-term and short-term debt) over the past 12 months

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_chginvavga.description: 12-month change in quarterly total inventory, normalized by the average assets between the most recent quarter-end and the same quarter one year prior

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_chgqtrepss.description: Change in Real Earnings Surprise : It is defined as the change in quarterly earnings surprise (Actual EPS - Consensus Estimate EPS), scaled by the most recent closing price.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_dm.description: A score representing financial distress risk, calculated using the Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi model and/or Chen and Zhang’s model

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_earnshortf.description: Earnings Shortfall : It is defined as the difference between reported accounting earnings and free cash flow, scaled by average assets.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_emeasales.description: Company’s sales revenue exposure to the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region, expressed as a proportion of total sales

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_impvol.description: Implied volatility estimate derived from options markets for the stock, reflecting expected future market volatility

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_irttmsales.description: Stock's trailing 12 month sales-to-enterprise (SEV) value less the average of the SEVs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the SEVs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_lasales.description: Company’s sales revenue exposure to Latin America, expressed as a proportion of total sales

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_nasales.description: Company’s sales revenue exposure to North America, expressed as a proportion of total sales

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_ney.description: Normalized Earnings Yield : It is defined as the average of three normalized earnings calculated by ROE, NPM and EPS FY2, scaled by price.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_pbroeresid.description: Adjusted price-to-book signal incorporating firm growth, based on Wilcox and Philips (2005), representing the residual from combining price-to-book and return-on-equity

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_rev3my1std.description: The change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 1 less that of three months ago, scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts as of three months ago.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_rev3my2std.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: Dispersion Relative : It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of three months ago, scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts as of three months ago.

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_ttmocfev.description: Trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share divided by enterprise value per share; a valuation and quality metric

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_ttmopincev.description: Trailing 12-month operating income (before depreciation/amortization) divided by enterprise value, where EV = Equity Market Value + Debt + Preferred Shares + Minority Interest - Cash

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_vix.description: Sensitivity of the stock or factor to changes in the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX), a market volatility measure

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_y2aepsgpc.description: Percentage change in consensus analyst EPS forecast from fiscal year 1 to fiscal year 2, normalized by year 1 forecast (forward growth rate)

mdl177_2_sensitivityfactor400_yieldsprd.description: Sensitivity of the stock or factor to changes in the slope of the yield curve, measured as the difference between long- and short-term interest rates

mdl177_2_surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_compos.description: Aggregate rank that combines several surprise-related analyst metrics into a single composite score

mdl177_2_surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_estexp.description: Rank indicating the trend or direction of analyst estimate changes for a company (estimate trend rank)

mdl177_2_surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_percen.description: Estimated probability (in percent) that a company will deliver an earnings or revenue surprise

mdl177_2_surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_surpsn.description: Rank of a company's earnings or revenue surprise, normalized relative to its sector (sector-neutral surprise analyst rank)

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_capexdep.description: Rank based on the ratio of capital expenditures to depreciation, showing investment intensity or asset renewal

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_cashflow.description: Rank of free cash flow relative to market capitalization

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_chgacc.description: Rank based on change in net operating working capital, reflecting shifts in operational liquidity or efficiency

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_chgato.description: Rank based on change in asset turnover ratio (sales/assets), indicating improvements or declines in efficiency

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_chginv.description: Rank based on change in inventory levels, typically signaling operational efficiency or demand shifts

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_composite.description: Composite rank combining multiple value analyst measures for overall scoring

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_earnquali.description: Rank based on the quality and sustainability of earnings

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_earnval.description: Rank based on valuation of earnings, such as P/E or related metrics

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_epmodule.description: Rank based on cyclicality of company earnings, measuring how variable or stable earnings are

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_finstmt.description: Composite rank based on multiple financial statement metrics

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_incstmt.description: Rank of operating income in relation to enterprise value based on income statement data

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_pegy.description: Rank based on PEGY ratio (Price/Earnings to Growth & Yield), assessing valuation adjusted for earnings growth and dividend yield

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_shortfall.description: Rank based on earnings shortfall, flagging how much reported earnings fell below expectations

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_valuation.description: Overall valuation rank, likely reflecting various value measures

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_yoychgdeb.description: Rank based on year-over-year change in debt issuance, indicating leverage dynamics

mdl177_2_valueanalystmodel_qva_yoychgsha.description: Rank based on year-over-year change in shares outstanding, reflecting dilution or buybacks

mdl177_2_valuemomemtummodel_earningsexpe.description: A module tracking market expectations regarding the company's future earnings, often based on analyst forecasts or consensus estimates

mdl177_2_valuemomemtummodel_pricemomentu.description: A factor signal module measuring price momentum, i.e., recent upward or downward movement in the company’s stock price

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2.description: Value Momentum Analyst II overall composite score combining Value and Momentum components

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_ma.description: Momentum Analyst II composite score aggregating price momentum, earnings momentum, expectations, and fundamental growth signals

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_ma_ee.description: Earnings Expectations subscore within the Momentum Analyst II component, reflecting analyst forecasts and revisions momentum

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_ma_em.description: Reported Earnings Momentum subscore within the Momentum Analyst II component, tracking momentum in realized earnings results and surprises

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_ma_fg.description: Fundamental Growth subscore within the Momentum Analyst II component, measuring growth in fundamentals such as sales, EPS, and cash flow

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_ma_pm.description: Price Momentum; measures price trend or momentum for the stock over a selected period

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_va.description: Value Analyst II composite score aggregating valuation-oriented subscores (Earnings Quality, Earnings Valuation, Financial Statement Valuation, Investor Sentiment)

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_va_eq.description: Earnings Quality subscore within the Value Analyst II component, capturing the reliability and sustainability of earnings (e.g., accruals quality, consistency)

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_va_ev.description: Earnings Valuation subscore within the Value Analyst II component, focused on earnings-based valuation ratios (e.g., P/E, EV/EBITDA)

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_va_fs.description: Financial Statement Valuation subscore within the Value Analyst II component, based on ratios from financial statements (e.g., book, earnings, cash flow)

mdl177_2_vma2_vma2_va_is.description: Investor Sentiment subscore within the Value Analyst II component, capturing valuation-related sentiment and investor behavior indicators

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_act_util.description: Actual Utilization Rate: the real observed proportion of shares lent out (actively used for short selling) versus available supply

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_benchmark_f.description: Implied loan rate or benchmark borrowing fee in the securities lending market

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_conc_ratio.description: Short Concentration Ratio: measures the degree to which short interest is concentrated in a limited number of stocks, indicating potential crowding risk in short positions

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_days_to_cov.description: Days to Cover: number of days it would take for all current short positions to be repurchased (covered), given average trading volume; reflects potential risk of short squeezes

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_dmd_conc.description: Demand value concentration: degree to which borrowing demand is concentrated among a few borrowers

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_dmd_supply.description: Demand-to-supply ratio in securities lending, indicating borrow demand relative to lendable supply

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_inv_conc.description: Inventory value concentration: degree to which lending inventory is concentrated among a few lenders

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_lend_supply.description: Lending Supply: the total quantity of shares available for lending in the market, reflecting liquidity for short sellers

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_onloan_conc.description: On Loan Concentration: degree to which stocks on loan (for short selling) are concentrated in a few names, signifying crowding and potential risk in short positions

mdl177_5shortsentimentfactor_sht_int.description: Short Interest: the total number of shares currently sold short (but not yet covered), a key indicator of bearish sentiment in a stock

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_acqmul_alt.description: Acquisition Multiple: most recent invested capital divided by trailing 12-month EBITDA

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_bp_alt.description: Book-to-Price: most recent book value per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_cashp_alt.description: Cash-to-Price: most recently reported cash and equivalents per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_cashsev_alt.description: Cash-to-Enterprise Value: total cash and equivalents divided by enterprise value

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_coreepsp_alt.description: TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: trailing 12-month operational/core EPS excluding special items divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_divyield_alt.description: TTM Dividend Yield: trailing 12-month dividends per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ebitdaev_alt.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: trailing 12-month EBITDA divided by enterprise value

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ebitdap_alt.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Price: trailing 12-month EBITDA divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ebop_alt.description: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson Value-to-Price: valuation from the EBO model divided by market price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_fwdep_alt.description: Forward 12-month Earnings-to-Price: next four quarters’ mean consensus EPS divided by price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_indidivy_alt.description: Indicated Dividend Yield: expected annualized dividend divided by price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_navp_alt.description: Ratio of a company’s net asset value per share (tangible book value) to its current share price, indicating how much balance-sheet net worth backs each share relative to market value

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_nnastp_alt.description: Net Current Assets-to-Price: current assets minus total liabilities per share divided by price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_past_alt.description: Price-to-Total Assets: trading price divided by most recent total assets per share

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_proformaep_alt.description: TTM Pro Forma Earnings-to-Price: trailing 12-month adjusted/pro forma earnings per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmcapexp_alt.description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Price: trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmcfp_alt.description: TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: trailing 12-month net income plus depreciation per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmepa_alt.description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmepb_alt.description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account of non-recurring gain or loss.stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmfcfev_alt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by enterprise value

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmfcfp_alt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: trailing 12-month free cash flow per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmgfp_alt.description: TTM Growth Flow-to-Price: trailing four quarters GAAP earnings plus R&D expenses per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmocfp_alt.description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmpiqp_alt.description: TTM Pretax Income-to-Price: trailing 12-month pretax income per share divided by trading price

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmsaleev_alt.description: TTM Sales-to-Enterprise Value: trailing 12-month sales divided by enterprise value

mdl177_deepvaluefactor_ttmsp_alt.description: TTM Sales-to-Price: trailing 12-month sales per share divided by trading price

mdl177_devnorthamericashortsentimentfact.description: Actual utilization rate of lendable inventory currently on loan
Implied loan rate or benchmark borrowing fee for the stock in the securities lending market
Short concentration ratio, measuring how concentrated short positions or utilization are
Number of days required to cover current short interest based on average daily trading volume
Demand value concentration, indicating how borrow demand value is concentrated
Demand-to-supply ratio of borrow demand relative to available lending supply
Concentration of lending inventory value, indicating how supply is concentrated among a few holders
Total quantity of shares available to lend (lendable inventory)
Concentration of shares currently on loan, indicating how on-loan positions are concentrated
Short interest, the number of shares sold short and outstanding
Utilization: proportion of lendable shares currently on loan

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_chg6mltg.description: Percent change in consensus long-term growth forecast over past 6 months

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_chg6mltg_al.description: Percent change in consensus long-term growth estimate over previous six months

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_cvfy1eps.description: Forecast dispersion for FY1 EPS; standard deviation of analyst estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by mean

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_cvfy1eps_al.description: Dispersion (coefficient of variation) of FY1 earnings per share forecasts among analysts

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_cvfy2eps.description: Forecast dispersion for FY2 EPS; standard deviation of analyst estimates for fiscal year 2 earnings per share divided by the mean

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_cvfy2eps_al.description: Dispersion (coefficient of variation) of FY2 EPS forecasts among analysts

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of dividend yield-adjusted PEG ratio; valuation metric adjusting PEG by dividend yield

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_dypeg_alt.description: Reciprocal of dividend yield-adjusted PEG ratio

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_egp.description: Inverse of PEG Ratio; next 4-quarter earnings estimate times long-term growth rate forecast, scaled by price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_egp_alt.description: Inverse PEG ratio; EPS-to-price divided by growth rate

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_epsrm.description: Magnitude of street revisions; 3-month change in median FY1 consensus earnings estimate, scaled by price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_epsrm_alt.description: Magnitude of 3-month revision in median consensus FY1 earnings forecast

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_fcfroey1p.description: Product of trailing 12-month free cash flow yield and forward return on equity; combines FCF per share and next 4-quarter earnings forecast over book value, scaled by trading price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_fcfroey1p_a.description: Product of trailing twelve-month free cash flow yield per share and forward-looking return on equity (ROE), measuring company profitability and cash generation relative to price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_fqsurstd.description: Most recent earnings surprise; standardized value quantifying how actual earnings differed from consensus in latest reporting

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_fqsurstd_al.description: Most recent earnings surprise standardized (actual minus expected EPS)

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_fy1epsskew.description: Skewness statistic of the distribution of leading 12-month consensus EPS estimates, indicating asymmetry in earnings expectations

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_fy1epsskew_.description: Skewness of leading 12-month analyst EPS estimates

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_hlep.description: Street revision confidence; sum of 3-month change in highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimates, scaled by price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_hlep_alt.description: Sum of 3-month change in highest and lowest FY1 EPS estimate, scaled by price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_lagegp.description: Lagged inverse of PEG Ratio; trailing 12-month EPS before extraordinary items times change in yearly trailing sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_lagegp_alt.description: Inverse PEG ratio calculated using trailing 12-month EPS and sales growth rate, divided by price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_ltg.description: Long-term growth rate estimate; consensus annual growth forecast for operating earnings over the next full business cycle

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_ltg_alt.description: Consensus long-term earnings growth rate estimate

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_numrevq1.description: Net number of analyst revisions for fiscal quarter 1; weighted average of forecast increases minus decreases for Q1

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_numrevq1_al.description: Net number of analyst revisions for fiscal quarter one EPS estimates

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_numrevy1.description: Net # of Revisions for Fiscal Year 1

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_numrevy1_al.description: Net number of upward and downward revisions in FY1 EPS forecasts

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_perg.description: Risk-adjusted PEG ratio, calculated as stock price divided by leading 12-month consensus earnings forecast, scaled by average long-term growth rate estimate, and multiplied by the stock's 36-month beta

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_perg_alt.description: Risk-adjusted PEG ratio accounting for price, forecast EPS, growth rate, and 36-month beta

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_q1aepsg.description: Estimated EPS growth for the next fiscal quarter

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_q1aepsg_alt.description: Estimated growth in earnings per share for the upcoming fiscal quarter

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_qepsferr.description: Prior fiscal quarter forecast error; difference between actual and estimated EPS for previous quarter

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_qepsferr_al.description: Forecast error for prior fiscal quarter’s earnings (actual EPS minus forecasted EPS)

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_ratrev6m.description: 6-month average change in street analyst recommendations

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_ratrev6m_al.description: Six-month average change in analyst recommendation ratings, indicating shifts in analyst sentiment toward the stock

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev1q1.description: Revision in fiscal Q1 EPS forecasts; change in current Q1 forecast minus previous Q1 forecast

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev1q1_alt.description: Change in EPS forecast for fiscal quarter one

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev3y1.description: 3-month revision in FY1 EPS forecasts; change in current FY1 estimate minus 3 months ago, scaled

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev3y1_alt.description: Change in FY1 EPS forecasts over the past three months

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev3y2.description: 3-month revision in FY2 EPS forecasts; difference in FY2 estimates from three months ago to now, scaled

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev3y2_alt.description: Change in FY2 EPS forecasts over the past three months

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev6.description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_rev6_alt.description: Average of analyst earnings per share (EPS) estimate revisions for fiscal year 1 (FY1) over the past 6 months

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_salesurp.description: Sales surprise; positive or negative deviation in actual sales versus consensus forecasts

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_salesurp_al.description: Magnitude of actual sales exceeding or missing consensus forecast

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_stdevfy1eps.description: Standard deviation of FY1 EPS estimates-to-price; dispersion of FY1 analyst EPS forecasts scaled by stock price
Standard deviation of FY1 EPS estimates expressed relative to price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_stdevfy2eps.description: Standard deviation of FY2 EPS estimates-to-price; dispersion of FY2 analyst EPS forecasts scaled by stock price
Standard deviation of FY2 EPS estimates expressed relative to price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_stockrating.description: Consensus analyst recommendation for the stock
Consensus recommendation for the stock (e.g., buy/hold/sell)

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_sucf.description: Standardized measure of unexpected cash flow, quantifying the deviation of reported cash flow from expected values, adjusted for comparability

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_sue.description: Standardized unexpected earnings; deviation of reported earnings from consensus, usually normalized

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_sue_alt.description: Standardized measure of unexpected earnings, typically deviation from analyst expectations

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_surp.description: Real earnings surprise; difference between actual and forecast EPS prior to announcement, scaled by price at quarter end

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_surp_alt.description: Difference between actual EPS and consensus forecast, scaled by quarter-end price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_y1aepsg.description: 1-year ahead EPS growth; projected increase in earnings per share for next fiscal year

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_y1aepsg_alt.description: Estimated earnings per share growth for fiscal year one compared to prior year

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_y2aepsg.description: 2-year ahead EPS growth; projected increase in earnings per share for fiscal year 2

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_y2aepsg_alt.description: Estimated earnings per share growth for fiscal year two compared to year one

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_y2repsg.description: 2-year projected EPS growth; forecasted earnings per share growth over 2 years, likely scaled by price

mdl177_earningmomentumfactor_y3sur_alt.description: Volatility-adjusted projected earnings per share growth over the next three years

mdl177_earningsmomemtummodel_emm_composi.description: Composite score measuring earnings momentum using multiple signals within the model

mdl177_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_cvfy2eps.description: Dispersion of FY2 EPS forecasts: standard deviation of analyst estimates divided by mean consensus

mdl177_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_egp_alt.description: Next 1-year average earnings estimate scaled by expected long-term growth rate and stock price (inverse PEG-type measure)

mdl177_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fcfroey1.description: Product of trailing 12-month free cash flow yield and forward return on equity, scaled by stock price

mdl177_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fqsurstd.description: Most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual EPS minus consensus) standardized by the standard deviation of analyst EPS estimates

mdl177_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_numrevy1.description: Weighted average net number of FY1 analyst forecast revisions in a month (raises minus lowers) divided by total forecasts

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgeps.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items compared to 4 quarters ago (1-year growth)

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgeps_.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items now compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgfcf.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month free cash flow per share compared to 4 quarters ago (1-year growth)

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgfcf_.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month free cash flow per share now compared to 4 quarters ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgocf.description: 1-year percent change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share compared to value 4 quarters ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgocf_.description: Percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share compared to the value four quarters ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtra.description: 1-year growth rate in quarterly total assets per share, comparing most recent reported value to that of four quarters ago
Growth in most recent reported quarterly total assets per share compared to four quarters ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtrs.description: Growth in most recently reported quarterly sales per share compared to 4 quarters ago (1-year change)
Growth in most recent reported quarterly sales per share compared to four quarters ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_reinrate.description: Reinvestment rate: (TTM EPS before extras minus TTM dividends, divided by average book equity per share)

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_reinrate_a.description: Reinvestment rate calculated as trailing 12-month EPS minus dividends, divided by average book equity per share

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qcf3y.description: R-squared of the regression line describing 3-year trend in trailing twelve-month cash flow
R-squared of the trend line fitted to trailing 12-month cash flow over the past 3 years

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qeps3.description: R-squared of the regression line describing 3-year trend in trailing twelve-month earnings per share
R-squared of the trend line fitted to trailing 12-month earnings per share over the past 3 years

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qfcf3.description: R-squared value of the 3-year trend line for trailing 12-month free cash flow, showing how well FCF fits a linear trend
R-squared of the trend line fitted to trailing 12-month free cash flow per share over the past 3 years

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qocf3.description: R-squared of regression describing 3-year trend in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow
R-squared of the trend line fitted to trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share over the past 3 years

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qsale.description: R-squared value of the 3-year trend line for trailing 12-month sales, indicating fit to a linear sales growth trend
R-squared of the trend line fitted to trailing 12-month sales per share over the past 3 years

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_saleg5y.description: Difference between trailing 12-month sales per share and that 20 quarters ago, divided by average sales over prior 20 quarters (5-year growth)

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_saleg5y_al.description: Difference between trailing 12-month sales per share and sales 20 quarters ago, scaled by average sales in those 20 quarters

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_salegstdev.description: Standard deviation of year-over-year quarterly sales per share growth during last 12 quarters (sales growth variability)
Standard deviation of year-over-year quarterly sales per share growth during last 12 quarters

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_salesaccel.description: Acceleration of sales growth measured over the last four quarters
Change in sales growth rate over the most recent four quarters (sales acceleration)

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_se5yepsg.description: Difference between mean long-term residual EPS growth rate and 5-year EPS growth, divided by EPS growth stability

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_se5yepsg_a.description: Mean long-term growth rate minus 5-year EPS growth, divided by stability of 5-year EPS growth

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qcf3.description: Slope of 3-year trailing twelve-month cash flow trend calculated over prior 12 quarters
Slope coefficient of 3-year trend line of trailing 12-month cash flow per share

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qeps.description: Slope of the 3-year trend line for trailing 12-month EPS, measuring EPS growth momentum over 3 years
Slope coefficient of 3-year trend line of trailing 12-month earnings per share

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qfcf.description: Slope coefficient of 3-year trailing twelve-month free cash flow trend over prior 12 quarters
Slope coefficient of 3-year trend line of trailing 12-month free cash flow per share

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qocf.description: Slope of the 3-year trend line for trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share
Slope coefficient of 3-year trend line of trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qsal.description: Slope coefficient of 3-year trailing twelve-month sales trend; measures sales per share growth trend over prior 12 quarters
Slope coefficient of 3-year trend line of trailing 12-month sales per share

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_susgrowth.description: Maximum growth rate a firm can sustain without increasing financial leverage

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_susgrowth_.description: Maximum growth rate a firm can sustain without increasing financial leverage

mdl177_historicalgrowthfactor_totalsaleg.description: Yearly trailing twelve-month total sales growth rate (percent change vs. year ago)
Percent change in trailing 12-month total sales compared to the value one year ago

mdl177_historicalgrowthmodel_chgfcf.description: Change in trailing 12-month free cash flow over the past year, adjusted for average total assets

mdl177_historicalgrowthmodel_div5yg.description: 5-year growth rate of dividends paid by the company

mdl177_historicalgrowthmodel_emm_composi.description: Composite score capturing overall earnings momentum signals for the company

mdl177_historicalgrowthmodel_hgm_composi.description: Composite score summarizing various historical growth factors for the company

mdl177_historicalgrowthmodel_slope4qsale.description: The slope coefficient from a trend line regressed on the trailing 12-month sales per share over the past 12 quarters (covering 3 years)

mdl177_historicalgrowthmodel_susgrowth.description: The maximum sustainable growth rate for the company without increasing its financial leverage

mdl177_industryrrelativevaluefactor_curi.description: A stock's current book-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of BPs
A stock’s current book-to-price ratio minus the industry average, adjusted by dividing with the industry standard deviation (industry-relative book-to-market ratio standardized by industry)
A stock's trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of CFPs

A stock’s trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio minus the industry average, adjusted by dividing with the industry standard deviation (industry-relative TTM cash flow-to-price ratio standardized by industry)
A stock's trailing 12-month core earnings-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of CoreEPs

A stock’s trailing 12-month core earnings-to-price ratio minus the industry average, adjusted by dividing with the industry standard deviation (industry-relative TTM core earnings-to-price ratio standardized by industry)
A stock's trailing 12-month dividend yield minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of DivYields
A stock’s trailing 12-month dividend yield minus the industry average, adjusted by dividing with the industry standard deviation (industry-relative TTM dividend yield standardized by industry)
A stock's trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of EBITDAPs

A stock’s trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio minus the industry average, adjusted by dividing with the industry standard deviation (industry-relative TTM EBITDA-to-price ratio standardized by industry)
A stock's trailing 12-month EPS-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of EPs

A stock’s trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items-to-price ratio minus the industry average, adjusted by dividing with the industry standard deviation (industry-relative TTM EPS-to-price ratio standardized by industry)
A stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of FCFPs

A stock's forward 4-quarter analysts consensus EPS-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of FwdEPs

A stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of OCFPs

A stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-total assets ratio minus the industry average, deflated by the industry's standard deviation of OCFTAs
