mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_altmanz_alt.description: Altman Z-score: A composite measure predicting bankruptcy risk, calculated using a weighted sum of profitability, leverage, liquidity, solvency, and activity ratios

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_aqi_alt.description: Asset Quality Index : It is defined as the year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of current assets plus PP&E divided by total assets

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_astcomp_alt.description: Asset composition: total current assets divided by total assets from most recent quarter, indicating liquidity proportion

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_atmcallvol_al.description: Implied volatility of the nearest at-the-money call options, indicator of option market expectations for price fluctuations

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_atmputvol_alt.description: Implied volatility of the nearest at-the-money put options, measuring market expectation of downside risk

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_bap20d_alt.description: 20-day average of the bid-ask spread divided by price, indicating short-term liquidity cost for trading the stock

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_bdi_alt.description: Basic Defensive Interval: number of days a company's cash and receivables can cover daily operating expenses (COGS + SG&A)

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_beta_alt.description: 60-Month Beta : It is defined as 0.67 times the 60-month beta plus 0.33Beta is the covariance between a stock's monthly return and the monthly S&P 500 index return in the prior 60-month period divided by the variance of the monthly S&P 500 index return in the same period.

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_betasigma_alt.description: Product of the adjusted 60-month Beta (market sensitivity) and the 60-month Sigma (volatility of monthly price returns), a combined indicator of risk

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_booklev_alt.description: Book Leverage ratio: Total assets from most recent quarter divided by book equity, reflecting company capital structure

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_cashratio_alt.description: Liquidity measure: Most recent quarter’s cash and equivalents divided by current liabilities

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_ccd_alt.description: Current Cash Flow Debt Coverage Ratio: Most recent quarterly cash flow from operations minus dividends, divided by current interest-bearing debt; ability to cover debt

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_cfleverage_al.description: Cash Flow Leverage: Total liabilities divided by trailing 12-month operating cash flow, a stress test of cash flow coverage

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_covol_alt.description: Slope of least squares trend line of last 60 months’ monthly trading volume versus time; measures long-term volume trend

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_curratio_alt.description: Current ratio: Current assets divided by current liabilities (most recent quarter), indicating short-term financial health

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_cvvolp20d_alt.description: Ratio of coefficient of variation (volatility) of last 20 days’ closing prices to coefficient of variation of daily trading volume; measures price movement versus volume variability

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_de_alt.description: Long-term debt to equity ratio: Most recent long-term debt divided by book equity; measure of leverage

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_debtcf_alt.description: Sum of most recent reported long-term debt and short-term interest-bearing debt divided by trailing 12-month cash flow, showing company’s debt load relative to cash generation

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_dfl_alt.description: Degree of financial leverage: (Pretax income + interest expense) divided by pretax income, proxy for interest dependency and leverage effect

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_divcov_alt.description: Dividend coverage ratio: company's trailing annual operating earnings divided by annual dividends; reflects ability to pay dividends from earnings

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_flowratio_alt.description: Flow ratio: (current assets - cash & equivalents) divided by (current liabilities - short-term debt), measuring liquidity after excluding most liquid assets and debts

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_gear_alt.description: Capital gearing ratio: long-term debt divided by (total assets minus current liability); measures leverage excluding current liabilities

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_intcov_alt.description: Interest Coverage: Quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by quarterly long-term debt interest expenses; ability to meet interest payments

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_liqcoeff_alt.description: Liquidity coefficient: regression slope between monthly turnover ratio and monthly stock returns; indicator of liquidity-return relationship

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmni_al.description: 3-year mean absolute deviation of trailing 12-month net income, a measure of profit variability

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmsale_.description: 3-year mean absolute deviation of trailing 12-month sales, a measure of sales stability/volatility

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_milliq_alt.description: Stock illiquidity measure: Monthly average of daily absolute return divided by daily dollar trading volume

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_mktcappera_al.description: Market capitalization divided by number of analysts providing estimates; reflects stock interest or coverage per analyst

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_mktlev_alt.description: (Market value of equity + most recent quarterly book debt) divided by market value of equity; leverage measure linking debt and equity

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_monchgsip_alt.description: Monthly change in short interest position; measures month-to-month change in ratio of shares sold short to shares outstanding

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_netcashp_alt.description: Net cash to equity: (Quarterly cash and equivalents minus long-term and current debt) divided by current market value; shows net liquidity strength

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_nfaldebt_alt.description: Net fixed assets divided by long-term debt, reflecting long-term asset coverage of debt; higher values indicate better fixed asset support for debt

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_nlassets_alt.description: Natural logarithm of the most recent quarterly total assets; serves as a size metric

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_nlmktcap_alt.description: Natural logarithm of the cube of stock’s total market value; proxy for firm size (log-transformed)

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_nlprice_alt.description: Natural logarithm of the cube of the stock’s unadjusted closing price; log-transformed price metric

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_nlsales_alt.description: Natural logarithm of the cube of trailing 12-month sales; log-transformed sales size metric

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_nlvolcap_alt.description: Natural logarithm of (trailing 1-year average monthly volume divided by trailing 1-year average of monthly market value of shares); liquidity metric

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_numest_alt.description: Number of analyst estimates for fiscal year 1; proxy for analyst coverage

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_ocfratio_alt.description: Operating cash flow ratio: Most recent quarterly cash flow from operations divided by current liabilities

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_ohlsonscore_a.description: Ohlson bankruptcy risk score, assessing probability of bankruptcy using financial ratios and firm characteristics

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_oplev_alt.description: Operating leverage: Percent change in TTM operating income (vs previous quarter) divided by percent change in TTM sales (vs previous quarter)

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_pcurlia_alt.description: Current liabilities per share divided by closing price; reflects short-term obligations relative to market value

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_qr_alt.description: Quick (acid-test) ratio: (Current assets minus inventories) divided by current liabilities, most recent quarter

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_rerror60m_alt.description: Standard error of slope from least squares regression of last 60 months’ monthly returns against S&P 500 returns; measures model fit uncertainty

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_si_ratio_alt.description: Short interest ratio: shares sold short divided by average daily volume over last 30 days; estimates days to cover shorts

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_sigma_alt.description: Standard deviation of monthly returns over prior 60 months; measures stock price volatility

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_sip_alt.description: Short interest position: number of shares sold short as reported, reflecting bearish sentiment or hedging activity

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_tobinq_alt.description: Tobin’s Q ratio: (Market value of equity plus debt) divided by total assets (debt at book value); assesses firm valuation vs assets

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_totalcov_alt.description: Total coverage ratio: (Cash flow from operations + interest paid + tax paid) divided by (interest + principal paid); indicator of financial coverage ability

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_voldiff_pc_al.description: Difference between ATM put and call implied volatilities; signals option market sentiment and liquidity risk

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_volto_alt.description: Trading turnover ratio: Monthly total trading volume divided by total outstanding shares (recent); velocity of share turnover

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_yoychgcr_alt.description: Year-over-year change in current ratio; difference in current ratio (current assets/current liabilities) compared to same quarter last year

mdl177_liquidityriskfactor_yoychgda_alt.description: Year-over-year Change in Leverage : It is defined as the difference between the most recent reported quarterly total liabilities as a percentage of the reported total assets and the percentage for the same quarter one year ago.

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_alpha6m.description: Rank representing the stock's six-month alpha change, measuring abnormal returns over the past six months relative to a benchmark, used as a momentum factor

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_alpha6m_.description: Rank representing the change in alpha generated by the stock over the past six months, gauging its risk-adjusted outperformance relative to peers

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_chgnowc.description: Rank of the change in Net Working Capital (NOWC), reflecting shifts in short-term operational liquidity over a recent period

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_chgnowc_.description: Rank based on the change in net working capital, reflecting improvements or deteriorations in the company's liquidity position over a given period

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_composit.description: Momentum Analyst Composite Rank: an aggregated rank combining various analyst momentum signals for the stock
Overall composite rank of the momentum analyst model, typically aggregating multiple factor signals into a single momentum ranking

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_condsurp.description: Conditional Surprise Rank: a rank measuring the degree to which reported results have surprised analyst expectations, conditional on factors like earnings or other events

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_earnexp.description: Analyst Expectations Rank: a composite rank based on analyst expectations, specifically averaging earnings revisions and rating changes

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_earnexp_.description: Rank reflecting analyst expectations, calculated as an equal-weighted average of analyst earnings revisions and ratings change ranks

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_eplinkag.description: Earnings Price Linkage Rank: measures the relation between changes in earnings and price response, aggregating factors like change in free cash flow, relative return, market response, and net working capital
Rank representing the linkage between earnings and price, typically an aggregate of change in free cash flow, net working capital, industry-relative return, and market response to earnings

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_epsgrwth.description: Earnings Growth Rank: rank of change in trailing twelve month earnings per share, scaled by recent closing price, indicative of E/P
Rank of earnings growth, measuring changes in trailing twelve month earnings per share scaled by the recent closing stock price (earnings yield, E/P)

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_estrev.description: Estimate Revisions Rank: rank reflecting the difference between recent upward and downward revisions to next fiscal year EPS estimates over four weeks, scaled by the total number of estimates

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_estrev_a.description: Rank based on estimate revisions, capturing the difference between recent upward and downward EPS estimate changes over four weeks, scaled by total estimate count

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_indrelrt.description: Industry Relative 3-Month Return Rank: measures the difference between the stock's three-month return and its industry's three-month return, ranked cross-sectionally
Rank of the stock's 3-month return relative to its industry peers over the same period

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_lagprice.description: Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price Momentum Rank: rank of the difference between lagged 12-month return and recent 1-month return, scaled by standard deviation, indicating mid-term price momentum
Rank reflecting lagged price momentum, calculated as the difference between the stock's lagged 12-month return and recent 1-month return, scaled by standard deviation

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_mktrespo.description: Market Earnings Response Rank: rank of the 4-day return surrounding the company’s most recent earnings report, spanning two days before and after the event
Rank gauging market response to earnings, typically the four-day return spanning two days before and after a recent earnings report

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_ratingch.description: Analyst Ratings Change Rank: rank reflecting changes in analyst consensus ratings over the last 4 and 8 weeks
Rank measuring recent changes in analyst consensus ratings, based on trends in revisions over the last 4 and 8 weeks

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_relprice.description: Relative Price Momentum Rank: an aggregated rank combining lagged 12-1 month price momentum, risk adjustment, and 6-month alpha change to measure overall momentum relative to peers
Rank summarizing relative price momentum, often an average of lagged price momentum, risk adjustments, and six-month alpha change ranks

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_repearnm.description: Earnings Momentum Rank: an average ranking derived from both earnings growth and earnings surprise for a stock
Rank of earnings momentum, generally an average of earnings growth and earnings surprise rankings

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_rskadj.description: Risk Adjustments Rank: a rank aggregating volatility and growth subfactors, penalizing stocks with high volume volatility and return deviations

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_rskadj_a.description: Rank aggregating risk adjustments, penalizing high volume volatility and large deviations in return for a risk-informed ranking

mdl177_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_ttmfcfch.description: Change in TTM Free Cash Flow Rank: rank of the two-quarter change in trailing twelve month free cash flow, divided by its value two quarters ago
Rank representing the change in trailing twelve month free cash flow over two quarters, divided by the value from two quarters ago

mdl177_priceanalystmodel_qpa_composite_a.description: A composite price signal generated by the Price Analyst Model, aggregating multiple price-related factors to summarize overall price strength or momentum

mdl177_priceanalystmodel_qpa_indrs_alt.description: Industry-relative strength, quantifying a stock's price performance compared to its industry group

mdl177_pricemomemtummodel_indrelrtn5d_.description: Stock’s 5-day return minus the average 5-day return of all stocks in the same industry, normalized by the industry return standard deviation

mdl177_pricemomemtummodel_pmm_composite.description: Composite price momentum signal combining several individual price momentum indicators for a more robust measure of momentum

mdl177_pricemomemtummodel_rationalalpha.description: Rational Decay Alpha: Measures a stock’s historical 12-month market-adjusted excess return using the intercept from an OLS regression and a proprietary decay function

mdl177_pricemomemtummodel_relpricestreng.description: Industry-adjusted 12-month relative price strength: Stock’s 12-month price strength minus the industry average, deflated by the standard deviation of industry price strengths

mdl177_pricemomemtummodel_visiratio.description: Visibility Ratio: Most recent daily trading volume divided by average daily volume over the previous 50 trading days, a price momentum/liquidity indicator

mdl177_pricemomemtummodel_voldiff_pc.description: Difference between at-the-money (ATM) Put option volatility and ATM Call option volatility for the stock, indicating liquidity risk or sentiment skew

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_abr.description: Abnormal return around quarterly earnings release (excess return during period around earnings announcement)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_abr_alt.description: Abnormal Return around QTR Earnings Release; abnormal return calculated in the event window surrounding quarterly earnings announcement

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn12m.description: Percent change in stock price over the past 12 months, measured with a 1-month lag to avoid lookahead bias

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn12m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-13 to month t-1

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn18m.description: Percent change in stock price from 19 months ago to 1 month ago (18-month active return, lagged)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn18m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-19 to month t-1

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn1m.description: Percent change in stock price in last month

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn1m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-1 to month t

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn24m.description: Percent change in stock price over the past 24 months, measured with a 1-month lag to avoid lookahead bias

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn24m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-25 to month t-1

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn2m.description: Percent change in stock price over last 2 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn2m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-2 to month t

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn36m.description: Percent change in stock price from 37 months ago to 1 month ago (36-month active return, lagged)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn36m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-37 to month t-1

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn3m.description: Percent change in stock price over last 3 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn3m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-3 to month t

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn60m.description: Percent change in stock price over the past 60 months (5 years), measured with a 1-month lag to avoid lookahead bias

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn60m_alt.description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag; percent price change from month t-61 to month t-1

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn6m.description: Percent change in stock price over the past 6 months, measured with a 1-month lag to avoid lookahead bias

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_actrtn6m_alt.description: Percent change in stock price from month t-7 to month t-1

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_alpha60m.description: The intercept (alpha) from a regression of the stock's monthly returns against the S&P 500 over the past 60 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_alpha60m_alt.description: 60-Month Alpha; regression intercept of stock's monthly return vs S&P 500 monthly return over last 60 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chg6malpha18m.description: Nominal change in 18-month alpha over past 6 months
6-Month Nominal Change in 18-Month Alpha; the change during the last 6 months of a stock’s 18-month alpha, where alpha is the regression intercept of stock's monthly return vs S&P 500 over 18 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha12m.description: Change in 12-month alpha (regression intercept) over the past 6 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha12m_a.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-Month Alpha; 6-month change in 12-month alpha, regression intercept of monthly return vs S&P 500

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha36m.description: 6-month change in the 36-month alpha (regression intercept) of the stock

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha36m_a.description: The 6-month nominal change in a stock’s 36-month alpha, calculated as the difference in regression intercept (monthly stock return vs. S&P 500) over the past 36 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chgvolpre4y.description: Change in average trading volume over the previous 4 years (compares recent and past activity)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_chgvolpre4y_a.description: Change in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio compared to the 12-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio from 4 years ago

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_cvpre90dp_alt.description: Coefficient of variation of the last 90 closing prices: standard deviation divided by mean of those prices

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_ff10mrtn.description: Fama-French momentum factor (return over 10 months, often lagged by 2 months, standard risk factor)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_ff10mrtn_alt.description: Fama-French Momentum; percent change in price from month t-12 to t-2, a standard momentum factor definition

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_high52w.description: Ratio of the current (month-end) price to the highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_high52w_alt.description: 52-Week High; month-end price divided by the highest monthly close in past 12 months

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn4w_.description: Industry-relative return over the last 4 weeks: stock's return minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn4w__.description: Stock’s return in last 4 weeks minus industry average return over the same period, standardized by industry return standard deviation

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_po4_52.description: Price oscillator measuring difference or momentum between 4-week and 52-week price trends

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_pr_1536_alt.description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio; moving average of a stock’s price over the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average over the last 36 weeks

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_pr_30w75w.description: Ratio of the 30-week moving average price to the 75-week moving average price, indicating short vs long-term momentum

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_pvt51w_alt.description: 51-Week Volume Price Trend with 4-week Lag; price-volume trend indicator calculated over 51 weeks with a 4-week lag

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_rationalalpha.description: Rational Decay Alpha; market-adjusted 12-month excess return regression intercept, using a decay-weighted function

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_relpricestren.description: Industry-adjusted 12-month price strength: stock's 12-month price strength minus the industry mean, deflated by industry standard deviation
Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength; stock's 12-month relative strength minus industry average, divided by industry std dev

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_rsi26w.description: Relative Strength Index over 26 weeks (price momentum indicator, compares current price to price 26 weeks ago)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_rsi26w_alt.description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength; most recent closing price divided by that of 26 weeks ago, showing long-term momentum

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_rtn2nd6m.description: Return over the second most recent 6-month period (i.e., 6-12 months ago)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_sharpe36m_alt.description: 36-Month Sharpe Ratio; a measure of risk-adjusted return calculated over the past 36 months by dividing average excess return by the standard deviation of returns

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn.description: Skewness of excess daily returns (relative to benchmark) during past 90 days

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn_a.description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Excess Returns; skewness of daily excess (over S&P 500) returns in last 90 days

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn.description: Skewness of daily returns over the last 90 days (measures asymmetry of return distribution)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn_al.description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Returns; statistical skewness (3*(mean-median)/std) of stock's daily returns over last 90 days

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_slope52wp.description: Slope of trend line for stock price over the last 52 weeks (strength and direction of long-term price trend)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_slope52wp_alt.description: The 4-week lagged slope coefficient from the least squares regression of a stock’s closing price against time over the last 52 weeks

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_slope66wp.description: Slope coefficient of least squares regression of weekly closing price over the past 66 weeks, lagged by 4 weeks

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_slope66wp_alt.description: Slope of 66 Week Price Trend Line; 4-week lagged slope coefficient from least squares regression of last 66 weeks' closing prices versus time

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_sortinoratio.description: Sortino ratio, measuring risk-adjusted return using downside deviation rather than total volatility

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_sortinoratio_.description: Sortino Ratio; risk-adjusted return similar to Sharpe but penalizes only downside volatility, over unspecified period

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_tstalp.description: 1-year price momentum indicator (e.g., correlation of daily log prices over 260 trading days)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_tstalp_alt.description: 1-Year Price Momentum Indicator; correlation of daily log prices over last 260 days, scaled to measure trend strength

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_var24m.description: Value at Risk (VaR) calculated over the past 24 months, representing potential loss over that horizon at a specified confidence level

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_var24m_alt.description: 24-Month Value at Risk; minimum (worst) monthly price return over the last 20 months, a measure of downside risk

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_varresirtn.description: Variance of residual returns over past 24 months (measures risk not explained by common factors)

mdl177_pricemomentumfactor_visiratio.description: Visibility Ratio: recent daily volume divided by average daily volume over prior 50 days (trading activity indicator)

mdl177_relativevaluemodel_fc_estep.description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield; calculated as next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price

mdl177_v1_400_abr.description: Abnormal return around quarterly earnings release; measures stock's excess return in the event-window of earnings reports, likely relative to normal or market return

mdl177_v1_400_booklev.description: Book Leverage: most recently reported quarterly total assets divided by book equity, indicating the leverage ratio using book values

mdl177_v1_400_capexast.description: Capital expenditure-to-total assets: trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by total assets from most recent quarter

mdl177_v1_400_cashburnrate.description: Cash burn rate: negative of (cash from operations plus cash from investments) divided by (cash plus short-term investments); indicates rate at which company uses its liquidity

mdl177_v1_400_curindbp_.description: Industry relative book-to-market ratio: stock's book-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by standard deviation for industry

mdl177_v1_400_fc_proformaep.description: Trailing 12-month pro forma earnings divided by trading price; earnings-to-price ratio using pro forma (adjusted) earnings

mdl177_v1_400_fy1epsskew.description: Skewness of the distribution of analysts' leading 12-month earnings per share (EPS) estimates for a stock; measures asymmetry in analyst forecasts

mdl177_v1_400_indrelrecd_.description: Industry-adjusted doubtful account receivables: asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus industry mean, deflated by industry standard deviation

mdl177_v1_400_indrelrtn4w_.description: 4-week industry relative return: stock's 4-week return minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation of 4-week returns

mdl177_v1_400_indrelrtn5d_.description: 5-day industry relative return: stock's return in last 5 days minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation of these returns

mdl177_v1_400_p50_200ratio.description: Ratio of 50-day moving average price to 200-day moving average price; a measure of short-term vs long-term momentum

mdl177_v1_400_pctchgqtrast.description: Growth in total assets per share over the past year, comparing the latest reported quarterly total assets to those of four quarters ago

mdl177_v1_400_pcurlia.description: Current liabilities per share divided by closing price; measures proportion of liabilities relative to market value per share

mdl177_v1_400_pr_1536.description: Ratio of 15-week moving average price to 36-week moving average price for a stock; momentum indicator over medium and long-term periods

mdl177_v1_400_rdsale.description: R&D intensity: average research and development expenses over trailing 12 months divided by total sales in the same period

mdl177_v1_400_reinrate.description: Reinvestment rate: trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items, less trailing 12-month dividends per share by ex-date, divided by average book equity per share in the same period

mdl177_v1_400_roic.description: Return on Invested Capital: trailing 12-month net income and interest expense divided by average invested capital (common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, preferred stock)

mdl177_v1_400_sucf.description: Standardized unexpected cash flow; unexpected component of cash flow, likely measured relative to expectations or historical trend and standardized

mdl177_v1_400_sue.description: Standardized unexpected earnings; measure of surprise in reported earnings relative to analyst forecasts, standardized by historical volatility

mdl177_v1_400_tobinq.description: Tobin's Q: market value of equity plus debt divided by total assets; assesses whether market values firm's assets higher or lower than their cost

mdl177_v1_400_ttmaccu.description: Accounting accruals: trailing 12-month net income minus trailing 12-month operating cash flow, scaled by beginning total assets; measures quality of earnings

mdl177_v1_400_ttmsaleev.description: TTM sales-to-enterprise value: trailing 12-month sales divided by most recent enterprise value (EV: market value of equity plus long-term/short-term debt, preferred stock, minority interest, minus cash & equivalents)

mdl177_v1_400_uar.description: Unexpected change in accounts receivable: actual change in accounts receivable minus expected (prior year's closing balance multiplied by trailing 12-month sales growth), scaled by total assets

mdl177_v1_400_visiratio.description: Visibility ratio: most recent daily trading volume divided by average daily trading volume over previous 50 days; measures trading activity relative to norm

mdl177_v1_400_yoychgda.description: Year-over-year change in leverage: difference between most recent quarterly total liabilities as a percentage of total assets and the same percentage one year ago

mdl77_2400_chg12msip.description: 12-Month Change in Short Interest Position: It is defined as the 12-month relative change in short interest position (SIP), where SIP is the number of shares sold short versus total shares outstanding.

mdl77_2400_chg12mtotdebt.description: 12-Month Change in Total Debt: It is defined as the 12-month relative change in total debt, where total debt is the sum of long-term and short-term debt.

mdl77_2400_chginvavgast.description: Change in Inventory to Average Assets: It is defined as the 12-month change in the quarterly total inventories scaled by the average of assets at the most recent quarter end and 4 quarters prior.

mdl77_2400_chgqtrepssurp.description: Change in Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the change in quarterly earnings surprise (Actual EPS - Consensus Estimate EPS), scaled by the most recent closing price.

mdl77_2400_cpgspea2y.description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth Percentage Change: It is defined as a stock's most recent consensus analysts earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus forecast for year 1, divided by the consensus forecast for year 1.

mdl77_2400_ctpmto.description: The exponentially weighted put-to-call ratio for out-of-the-money options.

mdl77_2400_earnshortfall.description: Earnings Shortfall: It is defined as the difference between reported accounting earnings and free cash flow, scaled by average assets.

mdl77_2400_ga.description: Aggregate Gamma: It is defined as the open interest weighted sum of the gamma for all options associated with a stock.

mdl77_2400_impvol.description: Implied Volatility: It is defined as the average implied volatility of the nearest-to-expiration at-the-money option contracts.

mdl77_2400_irttmsalesev.description: Stock's trailing 12-month sales-to-enterprise (SEV) value less the average of the SEVs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the SEVs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_2400_md.description: Distress Measure: It is defined as the financial distress model employed by Campbell, Hilscher, and Szilagyi (2008) and Chen and Zhang (2009).

mdl77_2400_pbroeresidual.description: Price-to-Book Return-on-Equity Combination (PB-ROE): An adjustment to the classic price-to-book model incorporating firm growth, based on a variation of the model developed by Wilcox and Philips (2005).

mdl77_2400_rev3my1std.description: The change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts as of 3 months ago.

mdl77_2400_rev3my2std.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: Dispersion Relative: It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of three months ago, scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts as of three months ago.

mdl77_2400_rmi.description: Volatility Spread: It is defined as the average implied volatility of the nearest-to-expiration at-the-money option contracts, minus the stock's annualized volatility of the previous 21-day log returns.

mdl77_2400_vefcomtt.description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share for a stock divided by its per share Enterprise Value.

mdl77_2400_yen.description: Normalized Earnings Yield: It is defined as the average of three normalized earnings calculated by ROE, NPM, and EPS FY2, scaled by price.

mdl77_25rel5ycoreepsp.description: 5-yr Relative TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month core earnings-to-price ratio (CoreEP) minus the average of the CoreEPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the CoreEPs over the same period.

mdl77_25saleicap.description: The trailing 12-month total revenues divided by the average of the invested capital in the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ybp.description: 5-yr Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-market ratio (BP) minus the average of the BPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the BPs over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ycfp.description: 5-yr Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio (CFP) minus the average of the CFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the CFPs over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ydiv.description: 5-yr Relative TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as a stock's current dividend yield (DivYield) minus the average of the DivYields in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the DivYields over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yebi.description: 5-yr Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month EBITDA per share-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) minus the average of the EBITDAPs in the last 60 months, scaled by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yep.description: 5-yr Relative TTM Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) minus the average of the EPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the EPs over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yfcf.description: 5-yr Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) minus the average of the FCFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FCFPs over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yocf.description: 5-yr Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio (OCFP) minus the average of the OCFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the OCFPs over the same period.

mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ysp.description: 5-Yr Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio (SP) minus the average of the SPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the SPs over the same period.

mdl77_2_dvm_composite.description: Score based on a strategy that selects for stocks in a universe of stocks by comparing different financial metrics as a ratio.

mdl77_2_htwrgspe_amq.description: Earnings Growth Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's trailing twelve-month earnings per share, scaled by its recent closing stock price (E/P).

mdl77_2ad.description: Total Debt to Total Assets: It is defined as the most recently reported total debt divided by total assets.

mdl77_2adverint.description: Advertising Intensity: It is defined as a stock's advertising expense in the last fiscal year divided by last fiscal year's sales.

mdl77_2am_amv.description: Momentum Analyst II: This model is composed of 40% Price Momentum, 30% Fundamental Growth, 20% Reported Earnings Momentum, 10% Earnings Expectations.

mdl77_2amv.description: Score based on the equal-weighted average of the Momentum Analyst and Value Analyst ranks

mdl77_2av_amv.description: Value Analyst II: This model is composed of 30% Financial Statement Valuation, 30% Earnings Quality, 20% Earnings Valuation, 10% Investor Sentiment, and 10% Management Signaling.

mdl77_2capacq.description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

mdl77_2capdistp.description: The sum of trailing 1-year dividends for every share and the estimated trailing 1-year stock issued for each share, which is scaled by price.

mdl77_2ccacw.description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

mdl77_2chgreccast.description: YOY Chg in Acct Receivable to Current Assets: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent quarterly reported accounts receivable to current assets ratio from the ratio for the same quarter one year ago.

mdl77_2cusip_sedol.description: Unix modification time of raw file

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_apemtt.description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_bpemtt.description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account non-recurring gain or loss. Stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_cashp.description: Cash-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported cash and equivalents per share of a company divided by trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_cashsev.description: Cash to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the total cash & equivalents divided by the sum of the market value of common equity and book value of long-term debt.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_coreepsp.description: TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share from operations for a stock deflated by its trading price. This item excludes the cumulative effect of accounting change, discounted operations, extraordinary items, and special items.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_curep.description: Current Earnings Yield: It is defined as the sum of the most recently reported 3 quarters EPS and analysts' consensus earnings estimate for the current quarter divided by its price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_divyield.description: TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as the trailing 12-month dividends per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ebitdaev.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for a stock deflated by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ebitdap.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for a company divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ebop.description: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson Value-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's valuation based on the Edwards-Bell-Ohlson (EBO) model deflated by its trading price. EBO is a modified dividend discount model that measures a firm's intrinsic value by comparing generated earnings to the cost of capital.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_estep.description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_indidivy.description: Indicated Dividend Yield: It is defined as the last quarterly dividend declared multiplied by 4, scaled by month-end trading price. The dividend includes extras declared within the last 12 months.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_lumqca.description: Acquisition Multiple: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported invested capital divided by the trailing 12-month EBITDA.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_nnastp.description: Net Current Assets-to-Price: It is defined as the current assets per share minus total liabilities per share divided by the price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_past.description: Price-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's month-end trading price divided by the most recent quarterly reported total assets per share.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pb.description: Book-to-Market: It is defined as the most recently reported book value per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pedwf.description: Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate divided by the price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcf.description: Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing 12-month depreciation expense per share minus corresponding capital expenditures, divided by trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcmtt.description: TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flows per share for a stock scaled by its trading price. Cash flow is defined as the reported net income plus depreciation.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcomtt.description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfgmtt.description: TTM Growth Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the sum of trailing 12-month growth flow value per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Growth flow is the sum of Research & Development expenses and reported net income.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pqipmtt.description: The most recent trailing 12-month operating and nonoperating income per share before provisions for income taxes and minority interest for a stock deflated by its trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_proformaep.description: TTM Pro Forma Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings scaled by the trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_psmtt.description: TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month sales per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pvan.description: Net Asset Value to Price: It is defined as the most recent book value of net assets per share (NAV) by the closing price. NAV is calculated in general form by taking the total assets of a company and subtracting the value of the company's intangible assets (goodwill, patents, etc.) minus current and

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ttmcapexp.description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ttmsaleev.description: TTM Sales-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales for a stock divided by the most recent enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash & Cash Equivalents.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_vefcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_vesspem21f.description: Forward 12-M EPS-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the consensus forward 12-month earnings per share forecast divided by the sum of market value of common equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share.

mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ydp.description: Predicted Dividend Yield: It is defined as an assumed payout ratio multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price. The payout ratio assumption is 10% + 84% * Payout Ratio in last year - 38% * consensus long-term earnings growth rate.

mdl77_2deepvaluemodel_chgshare.description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding one year ago.

mdl77_2deepvaluemodel_indidivy.description: Indicated Dividend Yield: It is defined as the last quarterly dividend declared multiplied by 4, scaled by month-end trading price. The dividend includes extras declared within the last 12 months.

mdl77_2deepvaluemodel_vefcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_2dv_yoychgat.description: YOY Chg in Asset Turnover: Year-over-year Change in Asset Turnover

mdl77_2dvm_composite.description: Deep Value Composite: Deep Value Composite Score

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is defined as the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fcfroey1.description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fcus.description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fqsurstd.description: Most Recent Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fy1epssk.description: The skewness of the distribution of a series of leading 12-month earnings consensus estimates.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gspea1q.description: 1-Quarter Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent fiscal quarter consensus earnings forecast less the actual quarterly earnings recorded four quarters ago divided by its trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gspea1y.description: 1-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for the next 4-quarters minus the last 4-quarter's reported earnings, deflated by trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gspea2y.description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 1, divided by trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gtl.description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gtlm6ghc.description: 6-M Change in Long-term Growth Estimates: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent mean consensus long-term growth forecast as compared to those of 6 months ago.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_lagegp.description: Lagged Inverse of PEG Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items times the change in yearly trailing 12-month sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_mrspe.description: Street Revision Magnitude: It is defined as the 3-month change in the median FY1 consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the current mean earnings estimate.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_numrevq1.description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal QTR 1: It is defined as the number of fiscal quarter 1 upward earnings forecast revisions less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_numrevy1.description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_pelh.description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in the highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimate, scaled by month-end trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_perg.description: Risk-adjusted PEG Ratio: It is defined as the stock price divided by the leading 12-month consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the average long-term growth rate estimate, and multiplied by the stock's 36-month beta.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_pge.description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_qepsferr.description: Prior Fiscal Quarter Forecast Error: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecast scaled by the stock's price at the beginning of the quarter.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_ratrev6m.description: Street Rating Revision: It is defined as the 6-month average of the change in the average analyst recommendation tracked by

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev1q1.description: Revision in Fiscal QTR 1 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current consensus earnings forecast for fiscal quarter 1 less the earnings forecast of 1 month ago, deflated by the trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev3y1.description: The change in the analysts' projection on company's performance for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev3y2.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of three months ago, deflated by its trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev6.description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1: It is defined as the average of prior 6-month monthly changes in a stock's consensus analysts' earnings forecasts for fiscal year 1, scaled by previous month-end trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_salesurp.description: Sales Surprise: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly sales minus consensus sales forecasts, divided by the standard deviation of sales forecasts.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_spe1yfvc.description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_spe2yfvc.description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_stdevfy1.description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 1 earnings scaled by closing price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_stdevfy2.description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 2 earnings scaled by closing price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_stockrat.description: Street Consensus Rating: It is defined as the consensus recommendation for a company.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_sue.description: Standardized Unexpected Earnings: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings per share minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_surp.description: Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecasts prior to the announcement date, scaled by price at the end of the quarter.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_y2repsg.description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recently reported fiscal year earnings, deflated by trading price.

mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_y3sur.description: Volatility-adj 3-yr Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the consensus earnings forecast for the current quarter minus the actual quarterly earnings 12 quarters ago, deflated by the standard deviation of the actual quarterly earnings.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_emm_composi.description: Model composition based on earnings momentum

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fcfroey1.description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fqsurstd.description: Most Recent Quarterly Earnings Surprise: It is defined as a stock's most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of its analysts' individual earnings forecasts.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_numrevy1.description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_rev3y2.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_y2repsg.description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent consensus analysts earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recent reported fiscal year actual earnings tracked by and then deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_gtl.description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_pge_cf.description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_spe2yfvc_cf.description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_ccacw.description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_chgsgasale.description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and the yearly change in quarterly sales.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_chgshare.description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding one year ago.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_cogsinvt.description: Change in TTM COGS vs Inventory Level: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and the yearly percent change in inventory level.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_cre.description: Earnings Response Coefficient: It is defined as the slope coefficient between market-adjusted returns around the time of corporate earnings announcements and yearly change in quarterly actual earnings per share tracked by.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_dpcapex.description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs CapEx: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month depreciation expense and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month capital expenditure.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_epschgetr.description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month pre-tax income per share times the difference between most recent trailing 12-month effective tax rate and that of 4 quarters ago. The effective tax rate is defined as total tax expense divided by pre-tax income.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_indrelrecd_.description: Industry-adjusted Doubtful Account Receivables: It is defined as a stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the average of the receivables of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these receivables.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_lccau.description: Unexpected Change in Accrued Liabilities: It is defined as the difference between the most recent fiscal year's accrued liabilities and the expected accrued liabilities (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in the trailing 12-month sales) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_opincltd.description: Change in TTM Oper Income vs LT Debt: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_pau.description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Payable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts payable and the expected level of accounts payable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in costs of goods sold in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_pedu.description: Unexpected Change in Depreciation: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month depreciation expenses and the expected level of depreciation expenses (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in total fixed assets) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_rau.description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts receivable and the expected level of accounts receivable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in sales in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_saleeps.description: Change in TTM Sales vs. EPS: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted earnings per share before extraordinary items.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_salegpm.description: Change in QTR Sales vs Gross Margin: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in most recent reported quarterly sales and the yearly change in the quarterly gross profit margin.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_salerec.description: Change in TTM Sales vs Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_spefcn.description: Change in TTM EPS vs Oper Cash Flows: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted EPS before extraordinary items.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_ttmaccu.description: Accounting Accruals: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month net income and the trailing 12-month operating cash flow scaled by the beginning total assets.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_vniu.description: The difference of inventory between present and expected levels.

mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_yoychgaa.description: Change in Accruals to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items less the trailing 12-month operating cash flow, then scaled by the average total assets, then minus the scaled difference for the same quarter one year ago.

mdl77_2ee_am_amv.description: The equal-weighted average of the Monthly Net Number of forward earnings yield (1) Estimate Revisions and 3-Month Revision in such Estimates.

mdl77_2exdisspi.description: 24-Month Unusual Items to Sales: It is defined as the sum of the absolute value of extraordinary items, discontinued operations, and special items in the prior 8 quarters scaled by the average of trailing 12-month sales in the same period.

mdl77_2fc_curindfwdep_.description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's next 4-quarter's analysts consensus earnings estimates-to-price ratio (FwdEP) less the average of the FwdEPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these FwdEPs

mdl77_2fc_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

mdl77_2fc_ebop.description: Stock's valuation based on a model deflated by its month-end trading price. The model measures a firm's intrinsic value by comparing generated earnings to the cost of capital.

mdl77_2fc_fwdroe.description: Forward Return on Equity: It is defined as a stock's analysts earnings estimates for next four quarters divided by its most recent reported common equity per share.

mdl77_2fc_numest.description: The number of analysts' earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 for a stock.

mdl77_2fc_rel5yfwdep.description: 5-yr Relative Leading 12-Month Earnings Yield: It is defined as a stock's current next 4-quarter's consensus analyst earnings forecasts-to-price ratio (FwdEP) minus the average of the FwdEPs ratio in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FwdEPs over the same period.

mdl77_2fc_rev3y1.description: The change in the analysts' projection on company's performance for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its price.

mdl77_2fc_rev3y2.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its trading price.

mdl77_2fc_rev6.description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1: It is defined as the average of prior 6-month monthly changes in a stock's consensus analysts earnings forecasts for fiscal year 1, scaled by previous month-end trading price.

mdl77_2fc_stdevfy1epsp.description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 1 earnings scaled by closing price.

mdl77_2fc_stdevfy2epsp.description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 2 earnings scaled by closing price.

mdl77_2fwdroe.description: Forward Return on Equity: It is defined as a stock's analysts earnings estimates for the next 4 quarters divided by its most recent reported common equity per share.

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_avgrating.description: Avg Analyst Rating: Avg Analyst Rating

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_chgvaluation.description: 3M Chg in Valuation: 3M Chg in Valuation

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_composite.description: Analyst score based on growth and value investing attributes

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_relgrowth.description: Relative Growth Rank: Relative Growth Rank

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_relpegy.description: Rolling Relative PEGY: Rolling Relative PEGY

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_roefcf.description: ROE x FCF Rank: ROE x FCF Rank

mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_vfpriceratio.description: Value to Price Rank: Value to Price Rank

mdl77_2gdna_6351_rp.description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 36 weeks.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn12m.description: 12-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-13 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn18m.description: 18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-19 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn1m.description: 1-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-1 to month t.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn24m.description: 24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-25 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn2m.description: 2-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-2 to month t.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn36m.description: 36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-37 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn3m.description: 3-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-3 to month t.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn60m.description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-61 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn6m.description: 6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-7 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_actrtn9m.description: 9-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as a stock's price percent change from month t-10 to month t-1.

mdl77_2gdna_ags.description: SG&A Expenses-to-Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month selling, general management, and administration expenses divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

mdl77_2gdna_alpha60m.description: 60-Month Alpha: It is defined as the intercept of the regression line which best fits a stock's monthly price return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 60-month period.

mdl77_2gdna_aoer.description: Retained Earnings-to-Total Assets: It is defined as the reported cumulative retained earnings from the most recent quarter deflated by reported total assets from the most recent quarter.

mdl77_2gdna_aor.description: Return on Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of total assets in the same period.

mdl77_2gdna_apemtt.description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.

mdl77_2gdna_aspanratio.description: Stock's quarterly operating assets minus its operating liabilities deflated by the lagged total assets.

mdl77_2gdna_astcomp.description: Asset Composition: It is defined as the total current assets from the most recent quarter divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

mdl77_2gdna_astto.description: Assets Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales divided by the most recently reported quarterly assets.

mdl77_2gdna_beta.description: 60-Month Beta: It is defined as 0.67 times the 60-month beta plus 0.33. Beta is the covariance between a stock's monthly return and the monthly S&P 500 index return in the prior 60-month period divided by the variance of the monthly S&P 500 index return in the same period.

mdl77_2gdna_betasigma.description: Product of Beta and Sigma: It is defined as the product of the adjusted 60-month Beta and 60-month Sigma (standard deviation of monthly price returns).

mdl77_2gdna_bmpo.description: Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly operating income divided by the corresponding quarterly sales.

mdl77_2gdna_booklev.description: Book Leverage: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly total assets divided by the book equity.

mdl77_2gdna_bpemtt.description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account non-recurring gain or loss, divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2gdna_capacq.description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

mdl77_2gdna_capexast.description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

mdl77_2gdna_capexsale.description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Sales: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by trailing 12-month sales.

mdl77_2gdna_cashburnrate.description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

mdl77_2gdna_cashc.description: Cash Cycle: It is defined as the average inventory days plus the average collection days minus the average payable days.

mdl77_2gdna_cashp.description: Cash-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported cash and equivalents per share of a company divided by trading price.

mdl77_2gdna_cashratio.description: Cash & Equivalents-to-Current Liabilities: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly cash & equivalents divided by current liabilities.

mdl77_2gdna_cashsale.description: The mean value of company's assets in the trailing 1-year divided by the trailing 1-year revenues.

mdl77_2gdna_cashsev.description: Cash to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the total cash & equivalents divided by the sum of the market value of common equity and book value of long-term debt.

mdl77_2gdna_cfita.description: TTM Cash Flow from Investment to Total Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow from the investing portion of the cash flow statement divided by the last 4 quarters average total assets

mdl77_2gdna_cfleverage.description: Cash Flow Leverage: It is defined as the total liabilities divided by the trailing 12-month operating cash flow.

mdl77_2gdna_cfroi.description: Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

mdl77_2gdna_cg3ysales.description: The geometric growth rate of the trailing 12-month sales per share in the last 12 quarters.

mdl77_2gdna_chg3ycfast.description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow scaled by the average total assets in the same period.

mdl77_2gdna_chg3yepsast.description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus the EPS 12-quarters ago deflated by the average total assets per share.

mdl77_2gdna_chg3yepsp.description: The difference between the trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2gdna_chg3yfcfast.description: 3-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 12 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

mdl77_2gdna_chg3yocfast.description: 3-Yr Change in Assets-Adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow (OCF) minus the OCF 12 quarters ago, deflated by the average total assets.

mdl77_2gdna_chg6malpha18m.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 18-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 18-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 18-month period.

mdl77_2gdna_chgalpha12m.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 12-month period.

mdl77_2gdna_chgalpha36m.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 36-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 36-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 36-month period.

mdl77_2gdna_chgars.description: 1-yr Chg in Acct Receivable as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the change between the last reported accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales and that percentage 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_2gdna_chgnoa.description: Change in Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the year-over-year change of net operating assets to total assets, where net operating assets equal most recent quarterly short-term debt plus long-term debt + preferred equity plus common equity minus cash.

mdl77_2gdna_chgollev.description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash)

mdl77_2gdna_chgsgasale.description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales.

mdl77_2gdna_chgshare.description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

mdl77_2gdna_chgvolpre4y.description: 4-Year Change in the Average Trading Volume: It is defined as the change in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio (average monthly trading volume/total shares outstanding) as compared to the 12-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio 4 years ago.

mdl77_2gdna_cogsinvt.description: Change in TTM COGS vs Inventory Level: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and the yearly percent change in inventory level.

mdl77_2gdna_covol.description: 60-Month Trading Volume Trend: It is defined as the slope of the least squares regression line of the last 60 months of monthly trading volume against time.

mdl77_2gdna_curindbp_.description: Industry Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-price ratio (BP) less the average of the BPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the BPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_2gdna_curindcfp_.description: Industry Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio (CFP) less the average of the CFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the CFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_2gdna_curinddivp_.description: Industry Relative TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month dividend yield (DivYield) less the average of the DivYields of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the DivYields of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_2gdna_curindebitdap_.description: Industry Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) less the average of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same relative universe

mdl77_2gdna_curindep_.description: Industry Relative TTM EPS-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.
