mdl77_2mqf_nopatmargin.description: NOPAT Margin: It is defined as: (Net Income + Interest Expense*(1-Effective Tax Rate))/Net Sales. All items are for trailing 12-month. Effective tax rate equals income taxes for the trailing 12 months divided by the trailing 12 months' income before taxes.

mdl77_2mqf_ocfast.description: Operating Cash Flow to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net cash flow from operations divided by the average total assets.

mdl77_2mqf_ocfmargin.description: Operating Cash Flow Profit Margin: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow from operations scaled by the trailing 12-month sales.

mdl77_2mqf_ocfroi.description: Operating Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

mdl77_2mqf_ollev.description: Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash) in the current quarter

mdl77_2mqf_otvni.description: Inventory Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold divided by the average of inventory in the same period.

mdl77_2mqf_pca.description: Average Collection Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month reported accounts receivable times 365 and then divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

mdl77_2mqf_pinoa.description: Pretax Return on Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income after depreciation divided by the average net operating assets.

mdl77_2mqf_ppa.description: Average Payable Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold.

mdl77_2mqf_rdsale.description: R&D Intensity: It is defined as the average of the research & development expenses in the trailing 12 months deflated by the sum of total sales in the same period.

mdl77_2mqf_revper.description: Revenue per Employee: It is defined as the trailing 12-month total sales divided by the number of employees at the end of the last reported fiscal year.

mdl77_2mqf_roe.description: Return on Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of common equity in the same period.

mdl77_2mqf_roic.description: Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net income and interest expenses divided by the average reported invested capital, which equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

mdl77_2mqf_vnicw.description: Working Capital to Inventory: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported working capital divided by the inventory. Working capital is the difference between current assets and current liabilities.

mdl77_2mqf_wcast.description: Working Capital-to-Total Assets: It is defined as the average working capital in the trailing 12 months divided by the average total assets in the same period.

mdl77_2mqf_yoychggpm.description: Yearly Change In Gross Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported gross profit margin minus the margin for the same quarter 1 year ago. Gross profit margin equals the difference between sales and cost of goods sold then scaled by the sales.

mdl77_2mqf_yoychgroa.description: Yearly Change in Return on Assets: It is defined as the most recent trailing 12-month income before extra items as a percentage of total assets minus the percentage for the same quarter one year ago

mdl77_2mrspe_cf.description: The 3-month change in analysts' median earnings forecast for a stock's fiscal 1 scaled by the current mean estimate.

mdl77_2nef.description: Net External Financing: It is defined as the sum of the net cash from the change in common equity, the change in preferred equity, the change in convertible debt, the change in other long-term debt, and the change in short-term borrowings. All items are scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_2over.description: Overhead-to-Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income less depreciation minus income before extraordinary items scaled by trailing 12-month sales

mdl77_2pe_wt.description: Time-Weighted Earnings Yield: This factor uses a time-weighted combination of FY1 and FY2 earnings estimates to create a twelve-month forward earnings forecast. This earnings factor is a unique complement to the wide variety of earnings-related metrics available to determine a company's fair value.

mdl77_2pelh_cf.description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in the highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimate, scaled by month-end trading price.

mdl77_2priceanalystmodel_nspmoc_apq.description: Price Analyst Sector-Neutral: Price Analyst Sector-Neutral

mdl77_2priceanalystmodel_qpa_indrs.description: Industry Relative Strength: Industry Relative Strength

mdl77_2priceanalystmodel_srjdaksr_apq.description: Risk Adj Relative Strength : Risk Adj Relative Strength

mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel2_indrelrtn5d_.description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_rationalalpha.description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y-intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function.

mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_relpricestreng.description: Industry-Adjusted 12-Month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_visiratio.description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_voldiff_pc.description: ATM Put Volatility - ATM Call Volatility: It is defined as the difference between the time weighted average implied volatility of the 2 nearest to expiration at the money put options and 2 nearest to expiration at the money call options

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_5_4op.description: One minus the quotient of a stock's last 52-week price exponential moving average divided by its last 4-week price exponential moving average.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_6351_rp.description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 36 weeks.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn12m.description: 12-Month Active Return with 1-month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-13 to month t-1.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn18m.description: 18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-19 to month t-1.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn1m.description: 1-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-1 to month t.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn24m.description: 24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-25 to month t-1.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn2m.description: 2-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-2 to month t.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn36m.description: 36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-37 to month t-1.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn3m.description: 3-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-3 to month t.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn60m.description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-61 to month t-1.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn6m.description: 6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-7 to month t-1.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_alpha60m.description: 60-Month Alpha: It is defined as the intercept of the regression line which best fits a stock's monthly price return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 60-month period.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chg6malpha18m.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 18-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 18-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 18-month period.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha12m.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 12-month period.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha36m.description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 36-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 36-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 36-month period.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chgvolpre4y.description: 4-Year Change in the Average Trading Volume: It is defined as the change in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio (average monthly trading volume/total shares outstanding) as compared to the 12-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio 4 years ago.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_high52w.description: 52-Week High: It is defined as the month-end price divided by the highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn4w_.description: 4-week Industry Relative Return: It is defined as a stock's return in the last 4 weeks minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn5d_.description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_m42rav.description: 24-Month Value at Risk: It is defined as the minimum of a stock's monthly price return in the last 20-month period.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_m6dn2ntr.description: Second Preceding 6-Month Return: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-7.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_normalmf60d.description: The 60-day average of a stock's daily money flow divided by daily total dollar volume.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_ntrm01ff.description: Fama-French Momentum: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-2.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_p50_00ratio.description: 50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 200 days.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_pc_ratio.description: Put/Call Ratio: It is defined as the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration put option contracts divided by the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration call option contr

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_pctabv260low.description: Price Above Last 260-Day Lowest Trading Price: It is defined as a stock's current closing price divided by its lowest daily low price in the last 260 trading days.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_pd09erpvc.description: CV of Prior 90-Day Closing Prices: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's last 90 days closing prices divided by the mean of these prices.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_rationalalpha.description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_rba.description: Abnormal Return around QTR Earnings Release: It is defined as the sum of a stock's daily market-adjusted price return from 2 days before to 1 day after its quarterly earnings announcement. The market return proxy is the S&P 500 index.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_relpricestren.description: Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price-strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_sharpe36m.description: Changes in company's monthly profit in the last 3 years compared to its profit 3 months ago.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn.description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Excess Returns: It is defined as the skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily excess (compared to the S&P 500 index) price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn.description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Returns: It is defined as the skewness (measure of lack of symmetry) of the distribution of a stock's daily price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_slope52wp.description: Slope of 52-Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 52-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_slope66wp.description: Slope of 66 Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 66-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_sortinoratio.description: Sortino Ratio: It is defined as a stock's annualized average monthly total return over the last 36 months less the average annualized 90-Day T-Bill rate over the same period divided by the standard deviation of the stock's monthly returns in months when total return was negative.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_tstalp.description: 1-Year Price Momentum Indicator: It is defined as: (CORREL*(260-2)^.5)/(1-CORREL^2)^.5. CORREL is the correlation coefficient between the natural logarithm of stock daily closing price and the corresponding daily dates in last 260 days.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_varresirtn.description: 24-Month Residual Return Variance: It is defined as the variance of a stock's monthly residual return in the last 24 months. The monthly residual return equals the stock's monthly return minus the product of the multiplication of a stock's proprietary 60-month Beta by the S&P 500 index monthly retur

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_visiratio.description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_volpre6m.description: The 6-month moving average of average monthly turnover ratio.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w15tvp.description: This field determines the strength of trends and warns of reversals.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w57w03_rp.description: 30-75 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 30 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 75 weeks.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w62isr.description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's most recent weekly closing price divided by its weekly closing price 26 weeks ago.

mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w93ntr.description: 39-Week Return with 4-week Lag: It is defined as a stock's price change from week t-43 to week t-4.

mdl77_2put_put_capmod.description: Capital Strength Module: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Industry Relative ROE, Change in Shares Outstanding, Total Coverage and Change in Operating Liability Leverage factors.

mdl77_2put_put_cashburn.description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

mdl77_2put_put_chgalpha.description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the six-month change in a stock's twelve-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

mdl77_2put_put_chgoll.description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash)

mdl77_2put_put_chshrs.description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

mdl77_2put_put_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

mdl77_2put_put_equality.description: Earnings Quality Rank: It is defined as the equal weighted composite of the Earnings Shortfall, Change in Inventory, Change in Asset Turnover, Change in Net Operating Working Capital and Capex/Depreciations Ranks.

mdl77_2put_put_indepsp.description: Industry Relative Core EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

mdl77_2put_put_indestep.description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

mdl77_2put_put_indfcfp.description: Industry Relative Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) less the average of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_2put_put_momod.description: The mean of three components: unexpected changes in expense or profit, and consumer confidence report.

mdl77_2put_put_opincev.description: Operating Income to EV: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q operating income to enterprise value (OpInc/EV).

mdl77_2put_put_qualmod.description: Quality Module: It is defined as the aggregation of the Earnings Quality (90%) and Short-Interest Ratio (10%) factors.

mdl77_2put_put_siratio.description: Short-Interest Ratio: It is defined as short-interest to average monthly volume.

mdl77_2put_put_strevconf.description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in a stock's analysts' highest earnings forecast and change in analysts' lowest earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_2put_put_sucf.description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as a stock's most recent reported quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_2put_put_totcov.description: Total Coverage: It equals (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid) / (Interest + Principal Paid).

mdl77_2put_put_valmod.description: The weighted average of various financial ratios related to a company's profits.

mdl77_2qe_av_amv.description: Earnings Quality: This submodule is 20% 1-year Change in Asset Turnover Ratio, 20% Current Cash Flow Debt Coverage, 20% Capital ExpTo Depreciation Linkage, 10% Change in Inventory to Average Assets, 10% YOY Change in Accruals, 10% Earnings Shortfall, and 10% Capital Acquisition Ratio. There are addi

mdl77_2rel5yfwdep.description: 5-yr Relative Leading 12-Month Earnings Yield: It is defined as a stock's current next 4-quarter's consensus analyst earnings forecasts-to-price ratio (FwdEP) minus the average of the FwdEPs ratio in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FwdEPs over the same period.

mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_capacq.description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less than the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_fc_estep.description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_fmrelval.description: Fielitz & Muller Relative Intrinsic Value: It is defined as a derivative of the two-stage dividend discount model, to calculate a stock's intrinsic value. The formula uses projected long-term earnings growth rate, dividend yield, P/E ratio, and Beta. The expectation with this indicator is that stock

mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_pfcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_roe.description: Return on Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of common equity in the same period.

mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_rvm_composite.description: Model composite based on an asset's worth that takes into account the value of similar assets.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_actrtn9m.description: 9-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as a stock's price percent change from month t-10 to month t-1.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_apsales.description: Asia-Pacific Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for Asia-Pacific as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_capexdeplink.description: Capital Expenditures to Depreciation Linkage: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between ranked (1-1000) quarterly capital expenditures to assets and ranked (1-1000) quarterly depreciation to assets.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_ceroe.description: The trailing 12-month funds from operations divided by the average of the current and previous year.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_dsu.description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_emeasales.description: EMEA Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for EMEA as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_inflation.description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_lasales.description: Latin America Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for Latin America as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_nasales.description: North America Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for North America as reported by the company divided by total annual sales

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_oilprice.description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_pi.description: Industrial Production Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Industrial Production, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_prc.description: Credit Risk Premium Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Credit Risk Premium, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_sh.description: Housing Starts Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Housing Starts, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_ttmopincev.description: TTM Operating Income to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income (before depreciation and amortization) divided by enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_xiv.description: Market Volatility Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Market Volatility, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_yieldsprd.description: Yield Curve Slope Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Slope of Term Structure, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

mdl77_2sf_av_amv.description: Financial Statement Valuation: This submodule is the equal-weighted average of Price-to-Book ROE Combination, TTM Operating Income to Enterprise Value, TTM FCF to Enterprise Value, and Industry-Relative TTM Sales to Enterprise Value.

mdl77_2si_av_amv.description: Investor Sentiment: This submodule is the equal-weighted average of the Short Interest Position, 12-month change in Short Interest Position, and ATM Put-Call Volatility.

mdl77_2spe1yfvc_cf.description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_ccaghc_avq.description: The 1-year change in a company's trailing 4Q net operating working capital, scaled by current total assets.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_alertrank.description: The aggregate of the Earnings Quality (50%), Investor Sentiment (25%) and Management Signaling (25%) Rank.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_capexdep.description: Capex to Depreciation Rank: It is defined as a company's trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by the trailing 12-month depreciation.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_cashflow.description: Cash Flow Rank: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q free cash flow to market capitalization (FCF/P).

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_chgato.description: Change in Asset Turnover Rank: It is defined as the one-year change in a company's asset turnover (TTM Sales/Total Assets).

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_chginv.description: The one-year change in a company's trailing 4Q inventory, scaled by current total assets

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_composite.description: The equal-weighted combinations of ranks based on intrinsic value of stock and the quality of earnings.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_earnquality.description: Earnings Quality Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted composite of the Earnings Shortfall, Change in Inventory, Change in Asset Turnover, Change in Net Operating Working Capital and Capex/Depreciations Ranks.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_earnval.description: The equal-weighted average of ranks based on price, earnings, growth, and yield.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_epmodule.description: Earnings Cyclicality Rank: It is defined as the aggregated ranking of a company's 3-year low 4Q EPS to enterprise value, FY1 EPS estimate to enterprise value and industry-relative EP rankings

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_finstmt.description: Financial Statement Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Income Statement Rank (OpInc/Price), the Balance Sheet Rank (Cash/Price), and the Cash Flow Rank (FCF/Price).

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_invsentimen.description: The equal weighted sum based on a ratio of number of stocks and those that have been sold short by investors.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_mgtsignalin.description: The sum of the indicators based on the changes in the number of stocks, and the company's financial status.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_pegy.description: PEGY Rank: It is defined as the aggregated ranking of a company's price, earnings, estimated long-term growth, and dividend yield rankings

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_shortfall.description: Earnings Shortfall Rank: It is defined as the difference between recent 4Q operating income before depreciation and trailing 4Q earnings, scaled by a company's enterprise value.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_valuation.description: Valuation Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Financial Statement Rank and the Earnings Valuation Rank.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_yoychgdebt.description: Chg in Debt Issuance Rank: It is defined as a company's change in total debt over the last 12 months.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_yoychgshare.description: Change in Shares Outstanding Rank: It is defined as a company's change in common shares outstanding over the last 12 months.

mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_tmtscni_avq.description: Income Stmt Rank: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q operating income to enterprise value (OpInc/EV).

mdl77_2valuemomemtummodel_vm_compositesn.description: Model composition based on momentum with sector neutral

mdl77_2ve_av_amv.description: The equal-weighted average of financial ratios based on a company's profits.

mdl77_400_6351_rp.description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 36 weeks.

mdl77_400_booklev.description: Book Leverage: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly total assets divided by the book equity.

mdl77_400_capexast.description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter

mdl77_400_cashburnrate.description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

mdl77_400_curindbp_.description: Industry Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-price ratio (BP) less the average of the BPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the BPs of all stocks in the same relative universe

mdl77_400_curindebitdap_.description: Industry Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) less the average of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_400_curindep_.description: Industry Relative TTM EPS-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

mdl77_400_curindfcfp_.description: Industry Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) less the average of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_400_curindsp_.description: Industry Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio (SP) less the average of the SPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the SPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_400_fc_proformaep.description: TTM Pro Forma Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings scaled by the trading price.

mdl77_400_fcus.description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_400_fy1epsskew.description: The skewness of the distribution of a series of leading 12-month earnings consensus estimates.

mdl77_400_indrelrecd_.description: Industry-adjusted Doubtful Account Receivables: It is defined as a stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the average of the receivables of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these receivables.

mdl77_400_indrelrtn4w_.description: 4-week Industry Relative Return: It is defined as a stock's return in the last 4 weeks minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

mdl77_400_indrelrtn5d_.description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

mdl77_400_p50_200ratio.description: 50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in last 200 days.

mdl77_400_pctchgqtrast.description: 1-yr Change in Total Assets: It is defined as the growth in the most recent reported quarterly total assets per share as compared to that of 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_400_pcurlia.description: Current Liabilities-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly current liabilities per share divided by its closing price.

mdl77_400_rau.description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts receivable and the expected level of accounts receivable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in sales in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_400_rba.description: Abnormal Return around QTR Earnings Release: It is defined as the sum of a stock's daily market-adjusted price return from 2 days before to 1 day after its quarterly earnings announcement. The market return proxy is the S&P 500 index.

mdl77_400_rdsale.description: R&D Intensity: It is defined as the average of the research & development expenses in the trailing 12-months deflated by the sum of total sales in the same period.

mdl77_400_reinrate.description: Reinvestment Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items less the trailing 12-month dividends per share by ex-date divided by the average book equity per share in the same period.

mdl77_400_roic.description: Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net income and interest expenses divided by the average reported invested capital, which equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

mdl77_400_sue.description: Standardized Unexpected Earnings: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings per share minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_400_tobinq.description: Tobin q: It is defined as the market value of equity (E) plus debt (D) divided by assets (A), or (E + D)/A. D is measured using book values.

mdl77_400_ttmaccu.description: Accounting Accruals: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month net income and the trailing 12-month operating cash flow scaled by the beginning total assets.

mdl77_400_ttmsaleev.description: TTM Sales-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales for a stock divided by the most recent enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash & Cash Equivalents.

mdl77_400_visiratio.description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

mdl77_400_yoychgda.description: Year-over-year Change in Leverage: It is defined as the difference between the most recent reported quarterly total liabilities as a percentage of the reported total assets and the percentage for the same quarter one year ago.

mdl77_actrtn1m.description: 1-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-1 to month t.

mdl77_altmanz.description: Altman Z Score: Altman Z = 1.2* (Current Assets - Current Liabilities)/TA + 1.4*Retained Earnings/TA + 3.3*Earnings before Interest and Taxes/TA + 0.6*Market Value of Preferred and Common Equity/Book Value of Total Liabilities + 1.0*Sales/TA where TA denotes total assets.

mdl77_aspanratio.description: Stock's quarterly operating assets minus its operating liabilities deflated by the lagged total assets

mdl77_astcomp.description: Asset Composition: It is defined as the total current assets from the most recent quarter divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

mdl77_astto.description: Assets Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales divided by the most recently reported quarterly assets.

mdl77_atmcallvol.description: At the Money Call Option Implied Volatility: It is defined as the time-weighted average implied volatility of the nearest-to-expiration and next-nearest to expiration at the money call option contracts.

mdl77_cashsev.description: Cash to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the total cash & equivalents divided by the sum of the market value of common equity and book value of long-term debt.

mdl77_ccacw.description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

mdl77_chgnoa.description: Change in Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the year-over-year change of net operating assets to total assets, where net operating assets equal most recent quarterly short-term debt plus long-term debt + preferred equity plus common equity minus cash

mdl77_chgollev.description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash)

mdl77_chgsgasale.description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales.

mdl77_curratio.description: Current Ratio: It is defined as the reported current assets from most recent quarter divided by the current liabilities from most recent quarter.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_apemtt.description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_bpemtt.description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account non-recurring gain or loss. Stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_cashp.description: Cash-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported cash and equivalents per share of a company divided by trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_cashsev.description: Cash to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the total cash & equivalents divided by the sum of the market value of common equity and book value of long-term debt.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_coreepsp.description: TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share from operations for a stock deflated by its trading price. This item excludes cumulative effect of accounting change, discounted operations, extraordinary items, and special items.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_curep.description: Current Earnings Yield: It is defined as the sum of the most recently reported 3 quarters EPS and analysts' consensus earnings estimate for the current quarter divided by its price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_divyield.description: TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as the trailing 12-month dividends per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_ebitdaev.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for a stock deflated by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_ebitdap.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for a company divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_ebop.description: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson Value-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's valuation based on the Edwards-Bell-Ohlson (EBO) model deflated by its trading price. EBO is a modified dividend discount model that measures a firm's intrinsic value by comparing generated earnings to the cost of capital.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_estep.description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_indidivy.description: Indicated Dividend Yield: It is defined as the last quarterly dividend declared multiplied by 4, scaled by month-end trading price. The dividend includes extras declared within the last 12 months.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_lumqca.description: Acquisition Multiple: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported invested capital divided by the trailing 12-month EBITDA.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_nnastp.description: Net Current Assets-to-Price: It is defined as the current assets per share minus total liabilities per share divided by the price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_past.description: Price-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's month-end trading price divided by the most recent quarterly reported total assets per share.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pb.description: Book-to-Market: It is defined as the most recently reported book value per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pedwf.description: Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate divided by the price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pfcf.description: Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing 12-month depreciation expense per share minus corresponding capital expenditures, divided by trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pfcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pfcmtt.description: TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flows per share for a stock scaled by its trading price. Cash flow is defined as the reported net income plus depreciation.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pfcomtt.description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pfgmtt.description: TTM Growth Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the sum of trailing 12-month growth flow value per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Growth flow is the sum of Research & Development expenses and reported net income.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pqipmtt.description: The most recent trailing 12-month operating and nonoperating income per share before provisions for income taxes and minority interest for a stock deflated by its trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_proformaep.description: TTM Pro Forma Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings scaled by the trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_psmtt.description: TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month sales per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_pvan.description: Net Asset Value to Price: It is defined as the most recent book value of net assets per share (NAV) by the closing price. NAV is calculated in general form by taking the total assets of a company and subtracting the value of the company's intangible assets (goodwill, patents, etc.) minus current and

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_ttmcapexp.description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_ttmsaleev.description: TTM Sales-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales for a stock divided by the most recent enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash & Cash Equivalents.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_vefcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_vesspem21f.description: Forward 12-Month EPS-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the consensus forward 12-month earnings per share forecast divided by the sum of market value of common equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share.

mdl77_deepvaluefactor_ydp.description: Predicted Dividend Yield: It is defined as an assumed payout ratio multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price. The payout ratio assumption is 10% + 84% * Payout Ratio in last year - 38% * consensus long-term earnings growth rate.

mdl77_divcov.description: Company's trailing 1-year profits scaled by its annual dividends.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is defined as the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_fcfroey1p.description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_fcus.description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_fqsurstd.description: Most Recent Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_fy1epsskew.description: The skewness of the distribution of a series leading 12-month earnings consensus estimates.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_gspea1q.description: 1-Quarter Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent fiscal quarter consensus earnings forecast less the actual quarterly earnings recorded four quarters ago divided by its trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_gspea1y.description: 1-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for the next 4-quarters minus the last 4-quarter's reported earnings, deflated by trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_gspea2y.description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 1, divided by trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_gtl.description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_gtlm6ghc.description: 6-M Change in Long-term Growth Estimates: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent mean consensus long-term growth forecast as compared to those of 6 months ago.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_lagegp.description: Lagged Inverse of PEG Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items times the change in yearly trailing 12-month sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_mrspe.description: Street Revision Magnitude: It is defined as the 3-month change in the median FY1 consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the current mean earnings estimate.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_numrevq1.description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal QTR 1: It is defined as the number of fiscal quarter 1 upward earnings forecast revisions less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_numrevy1.description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_pelh.description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in the highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimate, scaled by month-end trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_perg.description: Risk-adjusted PEG Ratio: It is defined as the stock price divided by the leading 12-month consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the average long-term growth rate estimate, and multiplied by the stock's 36-month beta.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_pge.description: Estimates on the next 1 year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_qepsferr.description: Prior Fiscal Quarter Forecast Error: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecast scaled by the stock's price at the beginning of the quarter.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_ratrev6m.description: Street Rating Revision: It is defined as the 6-month average of the change in the average analyst recommendation tracked by

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_rev1q1.description: Revision in Fiscal QTR 1 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current consensus earnings forecast for fiscal quarter 1 less the earnings forecast of one month ago, deflated by the trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_rev3y1.description: The change in the analysts' projection on company's performance for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_rev3y2.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of three months ago, deflated by its trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_rev6.description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1: It is defined as the average of the prior 6 months' monthly changes in a stock's consensus analysts' earnings forecasts for fiscal year 1, scaled by the previous month-end trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_salesurp.description: Sales Surprise: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly sales minus consensus sales forecasts, divided by the standard deviation of sales forecasts.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_spe1yfvc.description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_spe2yfvc.description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_stdevfy1epsp.description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 1 earnings scaled by closing price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_stdevfy2epsp.description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 2 earnings scaled by closing price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_stockrating.description: Street Consensus Rating: It is defined as the consensus recommendation for a company.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_sue.description: Standardized Unexpected Earnings: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings per share minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_surp.description: Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecasts prior to the announcement date, scaled by price at the end of the quarter.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_y2repsg.description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recently reported fiscal year earnings, deflated by trading price.

mdl77_earningmomentumfactor_y3sur.description: Volatility-adj 3-yr Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the consensus earnings forecast for the current quarter minus the actual quarterly earnings 12 quarters ago, deflated by the standard deviation of the actual quarterly earnings.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_chgsup.description: Change in EPS Surprise: It is defined as the quarterly change in EPS surprise.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_emm_composit.description: Model composition based on earnings momentum

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fcfroey1p.description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fqsurstd.description: Most Recent Quarterly Earnings Surprise: It is defined as a stock's most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of its analysts' individual earnings forecasts.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_numrevy1.description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_rev3y2.description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_fc_y2repsg.description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent consensus analysts' earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recent reported fiscal year actual earnings tracked by and then deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_gtl.description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_pge_cf.description: Estimates on the next 1 year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

mdl77_earningsmomemtummodel_spe2yfvc_cf.description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_ccacw.description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_chgsgasale.description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_chgshare.description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_cogsinvt.description: Change in TTM COGS vs Inventory Level: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and the yearly percent change in inventory level.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_cre.description: Earnings Response Coefficient: It is defined as the slope coefficient between market-adjusted returns around the time of corporate earnings announcements and yearly change in quarterly actual earnings per share.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_dpcapex.description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs CapEx: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month depreciation expense and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month capital expenditure.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_epschgetr.description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month pre-tax income per share times the difference between the most recent trailing 12-month effective tax rate and that of 4 quarters ago. The effective tax rate is defined as total tax expense divided by pre-tax income.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_indrelrecd_.description: Industry-adjusted Doubtful Account Receivables: It is defined as a stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the average of the receivables of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these receivables.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_lccau.description: Unexpected Change in Accrued Liabilities: It is defined as the difference between the most recent fiscal year's accrued liabilities and the expected accrued liabilities (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in the trailing 12-month sales) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_opincltd.description: Change in TTM Oper Income vs. LT Debt: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_pau.description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Payable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts payable and the expected level of accounts payable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in costs of goods sold in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_pedu.description: Unexpected Change in Depreciation: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month depreciation expenses and the expected level of depreciation expenses (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in total fixed assets) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_rau.description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts receivable and the expected level of accounts receivable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in sales in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_saleeps.description: Change in TTM Sales vs. EPS: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted earnings per share before extraordinary items.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_salegpm.description: Change in QTR Sales vs Gross Margin: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in the most recent reported quarterly sales and the yearly change in the quarterly gross profit margin.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_salerec.description: Change in TTM Sales vs Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_spefcn.description: Change in TTM EPS vs. Oper Cash Flows: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted EPS before extraordinary items.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_ttmaccu.description: Accounting Accruals: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month net income and the trailing 12-month operating cash flow scaled by the beginning total assets.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_vniu.description: The difference of inventory between present and expected levels.

mdl77_earningsqualityfactor_yoychgaa.description: Change in Accruals to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items less the trailing 12-month operating cash flow, then scaled by the average total assets, then minus the scaled difference for the same quarter one year ago.

mdl77_emmcomposite_emm_composite.description: Model composition based on earnings momentum

mdl77_equityto.description: The trailing 12-month sales divided by the average of trailing 12-month reported book equity.

mdl77_fa_capacq.description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

mdl77_fa_ebitdaev.description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for a stock deflated by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_fa_fcfroi.description: Free Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

mdl77_fa_ollev.description: Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash) in the current quarter.

mdl77_fa_past.description: Price-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's month-end trading price divided by the most recent quarterly reported total assets per share.

mdl77_fa_pb.description: Book-to-Market: It is defined as the most recently reported book value per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_fa_pedwf_cf.description: Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next 4 quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate divided by the price.

mdl77_fa_pfcf_cf.description: Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the next 4 quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing 12-month depreciation expense per share minus corresponding capital expenditures, divided by trading price.

mdl77_fa_pfcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

mdl77_fa_pge_cf.description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

mdl77_fa_ppa.description: Average Payable Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold.

mdl77_fa_rq.description: Quick Ratio: It is defined as the current assets less inventories from the most recent quarter divided by the total current liabilities from the most recent quarter.

mdl77_fa_vefcfmtt.description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

mdl77_fa_vesspem21f_cf.description: Forward 12-M EPS-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the consensus forward 12-month earnings per share forecast divided by the sum of market value of common equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share.

mdl77_fa_y3fcq4vc.description: Stability of 3-yr TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the standard deviation of the prior 12 quarters' trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) divided by the mean of these CFs.

mdl77_fa_ydp_cf.description: Predicted Dividend Yield: It is defined as an assumed payout ratio multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price. The payout ratio assumption is 10%+84%*Payout Ratio in last Year - 38%*consensus long-term earnings growth rate.

mdl77_flowratio.description: Flow Ratio: It is defined as the difference between current assets and cash & equivalents divided by the difference between current liabilities and short-term debt. All items are from the most recent quarter.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_cg3ysales.description: The geometric growth rate of the trailing 12-month sales per share in the last 12 quarters.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3ycfast.description: 3-Yr Change in Assets-Adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow scaled by the average total assets in the same period.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yepsast.description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus the EPS 12 quarters ago deflated by the average total assets per share.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yepsp.description: The difference between the trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 12-quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yfcfast.description: 3-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 12 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yocfast.description: 3-Yr Change in Assets-Adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow (OCF) minus the OCF 12 quarters ago deflated by the average total assets.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_chgars.description: 1-yr Chg in Acct Receivable as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the change between the last reported accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales and that percentage 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qsales3y.description: The standard deviation of prior 12-quarters' trailing 12-month sales for individual share scaled to the mean of itself in the same period.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_cvopinc.description: CV of Oper Income per Share in Last 12 QTRs: It is defined as the standard deviation of the trailing 12-month operating income per share (OPINC) in the prior 12 quarters divided by the mean of the OPINCs in the same period.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_div5yg.description: 5-Year Dividend Growth Rate: It is defined as the 5-year growth in dividends.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_fcfequity.description: TTM Free Cash Flow to Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average book equity value in the same period.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_fcfghc.description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_fcghc.description: 1-Year Change in Assets-Adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow minus comparable trailing 12-month cash flow from 4-quarters ago scaled by the average total assets.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_fcoghc.description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average total assets.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_mpnghc.description: 1-Yr Change in Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly net profit margin (NPM) minus the NPM 4 quarters ago. Net profit margin is net income divided by total sales.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_mpoghc.description: 1-Year Change in Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating profit margin minus that of 4 quarters ago. Operating profit margin is income from operations divided by total sales.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3ycf.description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yeps.description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yfcf.description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to its FCF 12 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yocf.description: 3-Yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to its OCF 12 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgastto.description: 1-Year Change in Asset Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent asset turnover ratio as compared to that of 4 quarters ago. Asset turnover ratio is the trailing 12-month sales divided by the average total assets in the same period.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgcf.description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) as compared to the CF 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgeps.description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items as compared to itself 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgfcf.description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to the FCF 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgocf.description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change of a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to the OCF 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtras.description: 1-yr Change in Total Assets: It is defined as the growth in the most recent reported quarterly total assets per share as compared to that of four quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtrsa.description: 1-yr Change in Sales: It is defined as the growth in most recent reported quarterly sales per share as compared to 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pfcfghc.description: The difference between the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pfcfy3ghc.description: 3-yr Change in Price-adj TTM FCF: It is defined as the difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pfcghc.description: The difference between the trailing 12-month cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pfcoghc.description: The difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pfcoy3ghc.description: The difference between the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pfcy3ghc.description: The difference between the trailing 12-month cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow for a stock divided by its trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_pspeghc.description: The difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_reinrate.description: Reinvestment Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items less the trailing 12-month dividends per share by ex-date divided by the average book equity per share in the same period.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qsales.description: The conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month sales per share in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_saleg5y.description: 5-yr Sales Growth: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month sales per share (SALE) and the SALE 20 quarters ago and then deflated by the average of the SALEs in the prior 20 quarters.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_salegstdev.description: Sales Growth Rate Standard Deviation: It is defined as the standard deviation of the year-over-year quarterly sales per share growth rate during the last 12 quarters.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_salesaccel4.description: 4-Quarter Sales Acceleration: It is defined as the slope of the regression line between year-over-year sales growth and time.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_se5yepsg.description: Stability-Adjusted Residual Growth Rate: It is defined as a stock's mean long-term growth rate minus its 5-year historical EPS Growth, as calculated by, divided by stability of 5-year historical EPS Growth, as defined by.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_sighc.description: 1-yr Chg in QTR Inventory as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the most recently reported inventory as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales minus that percentage 4 quarters ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qcf3y.description: Slope of 3-yr TTM Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qeps3.description: Slope of 3-yr TTM EPS Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qfcf3.description: Slope of 3-yr TTM Free Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month free cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qocf3.description: Slope of 3-Yr TTM Oper Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_slope4qsale.description: Slope of 3-yr TTM Sales Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month sales per share in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_speghc.description: 1-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus 4 quarters ago EPS deflated by the average total assets per share.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_susgrowth.description: The maximum growth rate a firm can sustain without having to increase financial leverage.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_totalsaleg.description: Yearly TTM Total Sales Growth Rate: It is defined as the percent change in a company's trailing 12-month total sales (TOTSALE) as compared to the TOTSALE one year ago.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3fcfq4rqsr.description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM FCF Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month free cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3fcfq4vc.description: Stability of 3-yr TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the standard deviation of the last 12 quarters' trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) divided by the mean of the FCFs.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3fcoq4rqsr.description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM Oper Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3fcoq4vc.description: The standard deviation of the ratio for the values that a company generates scaled by its mean in the previous 12 quarters in a trailing 1 year.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3fcq4rqsr.description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3fcq4vc.description: Stability of 3-Year TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the standard deviation of the prior 12 quarters' trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) divided by the mean of these CFs.

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3speq4rqsr.description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM EPS Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items in the prior 12 quarters

mdl77_historicalgrowthfactor_y3speq4vc.description: Stability of 3-yr TTM Earnings per Share: It is defined as the standard deviation of the last 12 quarters' trailing 12-month earnings per share (EPS) divided by the mean of these EPS's.

mdl77_historicalgrowthmodel_div5yg.description: 5-Year Dividend Growth Rate: It is defined as the 5-year growth in dividends.

mdl77_historicalgrowthmodel_emm_composit.description: Model composition based on earnings momentum

mdl77_historicalgrowthmodel_fcfghc.description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

mdl77_historicalgrowthmodel_slope4qsales.description: Slope of 3-yr TTM Sales Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month sales per share in the prior 12 quarters
