mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_p50_200ratio.description: 50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 200 days.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_pc_ratio.description: Put/Call Ratio: It is defined as the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration put option contracts divided by the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration call option contr

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_pctabv260low.description: Price Above Last 260-Day Lowest Trading Price: It is defined as a stock's current closing price divided by its lowest daily low price in the last 260 trading days.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_pd09erpvc.description: CV of Prior 90-Day Closing Prices: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's last 90 days closing prices divided by the mean of these prices.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_rationalalpha.description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_rba.description: Abnormal Return around QTR Earnings Release: It is defined as the sum of a stock's daily market-adjusted price return from two days before to one day after its quarterly earnings announcement. The market return proxy is the S&P 500 index.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_relpricestreng.description: Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price-strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_sharpe36m.description: Changes in company's monthly profit in the last 3 years compared to its profit 3 months ago.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn.description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Excess Returns: It is defined as the skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily excess (compared to the S&P 500 index) price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median])/Standard Deviation.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn.description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Returns: It is defined as the skewness (measure of lack of symmetry) of the distribution of a stock's daily price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median])/Standard Deviation.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_slope52wp.description: Slope of 52-Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 52-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_slope66wp.description: Slope of 66 Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 66-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_sortinoratio.description: Sortino Ratio: It is defined as a stock's annualized average monthly total return over the last 36 months less the average annualized 90-Day T-Bill rate over the same period divided by the standard deviation of the stock's monthly returns in months when total return was negative.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_tstalp.description: 1-Year Price Momentum Indicator: It is defined as: (CORREL*(260-2)^.5)/(1-CORREL^2)^.5. CORREL is the correlation coefficient between the natural logarithm of stock daily closing price and the corresponding daily dates in the last 260 days.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_varresirtn.description: 24-Month Residual Return Variance: It is defined as the variance of a stock's monthly residual return in the last 24 months. mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_visiratio.description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_volpre6m.description: The 6-month moving average of average monthly turnover ratio.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_w15tvp.description: This field determines the strength of trends and warns of reversals.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_w57w03_rp.description: 30-75 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 30 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 75 weeks.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_w62isr.description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's most recent weekly closing price divided by its weekly closing price 26 weeks ago.

mdl77_pricemomentumfactor_w93ntr.description: 39-Week Return with 4-Week Lag: It is defined as a stock's price change from week t-43 to week t-4.

mdl77_put_put_capmod.description: Capital Strength Module: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Industry Relative ROE, Change in Shares Outstanding, Total Coverage, and Change in Operating Liability Leverage factors.

mdl77_put_put_cashburn.description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

mdl77_put_put_chgalpha.description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

mdl77_put_put_chgoll.description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash)

mdl77_put_put_chshrs.description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

mdl77_put_put_composite.description: Custom Small Cap Composite: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Momentum, Quality, Valuation, and Capital Strength modules.

mdl77_put_put_dypeg.description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

mdl77_put_put_equality.description: Earnings Quality Rank: It is defined as the equal weighted composite of the Earnings Shortfall, Change in Inventory, Change in Asset Turnover, Change in Net Operating Working Capital and Capex/Depreciations Ranks.

mdl77_put_put_indepsp.description: Industry Relative Core EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

mdl77_put_put_indestep.description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

mdl77_put_put_indfcfp.description: Industry Relative Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) less the average of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

mdl77_put_put_momod.description: The mean of three components: unexpected changes in expense or profit, and the consumer confidence report.

mdl77_put_put_opincev.description: Operating Income to EV: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q operating income to enterprise value (OpInc/EV).

mdl77_put_put_qualmod.description: Quality Module: It is defined as the aggregation of the Earnings Quality (90%) and Short-Interest Ratio (10%) factors.

mdl77_put_put_siratio.description: Short-Interest Ratio: It is defined as short-interest to average monthly volume.

mdl77_put_put_strevconf.description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in a stock's analysts' highest earnings forecast and change in analysts' lowest earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 by its month-end trading price.

mdl77_put_put_sucf.description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as a stock's most recent reported quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

mdl77_put_put_totcov.description: Total Coverage: It equals (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid) / (Interest + Principal Paid).

mdl77_relativevaluemodel_fc_estep.description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

mdl77_relativevaluemodel_roe.description: Return on Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of common equity in the same period.

mdl77_rerror60m.description: Regression Error of 60-Month CAPM: It is defined as the standard error of the slope of the least squares regression line for a stock's last 60-month monthly returns against the S&P 500 Index returns.

mdl77_sighc.description: 1-yr Chg in QTR Inventory as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the most recently reported inventory as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales minus that percentage 4 quarters ago.
